updates.title: Introducing email action in company and custom object workflows
updates.content:
**Email Actions in Company & Custom Object Workflows**

Automated emails are coming to Company and Custom Object workflows — no more limiting this capability to contact-based workflows alone.

**What's coming:**

- Send automated emails directly from workflows built on Company records or any Custom Object
- Target associated contacts without adding extra workflow logic or triggering processes manually
- Choose which associated contacts receive the email — earliest, most recent, or all
- Select up to 10 association labels per email action, with built-in deduplication so no contact receives the same email twice
- Supports a wide range of business processes that go beyond standard contact workflows

This is currently in development and will be available in Kayan.ai soon.

updates.title: Social Planner: Post Sync for LinkedIn & TikTok (Beta)
updates.content:
**Social Planner: Post Sync for LinkedIn & TikTok (Beta) — Coming Soon**

Post Sync for LinkedIn and TikTok is coming to Kayan's Social Planner, giving you a unified view of your published content history alongside your scheduled posts — no manual imports required.

**What's coming:**

- **LinkedIn Post Sync** — Pull your published LinkedIn Organization Page posts directly into the Social Planner; view historical content and track reactions, comments, and shares alongside your content calendar
- **TikTok Post Sync** — Import published TikTok videos (Personal and Business accounts supported) and monitor likes, comments, shares, and views from one place
- **Automatic daily metric refresh** — Engagement data for both platforms updates every 24 hours, keeping your analytics current within platform API limits
- **Unified publishing calendar** — Manage historical and scheduled content across LinkedIn and TikTok alongside your other connected social accounts

**Good to know before it launches:**

- LinkedIn sync supports Organization Pages only — personal profiles are not supported due to API limitations
- PDF, Event, Poll, and Article post types will sync but won't support in-app previews
- TikTok videos play via TikTok's hosted player; cloning synced videos into new posts is not supported
- Sync is one-way — posts deleted on LinkedIn or TikTok will remain visible in the Social Planner
- Mentions, tagged users, hashtag details, location tags, and music metadata are unavailable due to platform API restrictions

This feature is currently in Beta. Full availability and setup instructions will be shared on release.

updates.title: Make Your Sites AI-Ready with llms.txt
updates.content:
**Make Your Sites AI-Ready with llms.txt**

You can now configure and manage an `llms.txt` file for each of your domains directly inside Kayan. Once saved, your file is served automatically at `https://<domain>/llms.txt` — no extra hosting or setup required.

**What's new:**
- Native hosting of your `llms.txt` as a clean Markdown map at your domain root
- In-platform editing — add and update content without touching external tools
- Per-domain control so each connected domain can have its own tailored file
- Passes Google PageSpeed Agentic Browsing checks out of the box, supporting AI search visibility (AEO/GEO)

**How to set it up:**
1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Sites** and open **Settings → Domains**
2. Select the domain you want to configure and open its settings modal
3. Scroll to the **llms.txt** section
4. Add or edit your site map content in Markdown
5. Save — your file publishes instantly to `https://<domain>/llms.txt`

updates.title: Trigger Automation in Bulk for Companies & Custom Objects
updates.content:
**Bulk Automation Triggers for Companies & Custom Objects**

You can now trigger automations across multiple Company or Custom Object records at once — no more running workflows one record at a time.

**What's new:**
- Select multiple Company or Custom Object records from the list view and trigger an automation in bulk
- Choose which workflow to run without touching each record individually
- Monitor progress and review per-record results directly from the Bulk Actions panel

**Why it matters:**
Some automations need to run on records that already exist — not just new ones coming in. This lets you act on a group immediately, whether that's onboarding a batch of companies, firing renewal workflows for policies or subscriptions, or processing a freshly imported set of custom records.

**How to set it up:**
1. In your Kayan dashboard, open **Companies** or navigate to the relevant **Custom Object**
2. Select the records you want to process
3. Click **Trigger Automation**
4. Choose the workflow you want to run
5. Confirm the action
6. Track progress and results under **Bulk Actions**

updates.title: ✨ Guest Enhancements in Calendars — More Flexible Guest Details
updates.content:
**Guest Management in Calendars — More Flexible Guest Details**

You can now control exactly what information you collect from guests during booking, and guest contact records are more accurate from the start.

**What's new:**

- **Flexible guest detail fields** — Choose which information to collect per calendar:
  - Name & Email
  - Name & Phone
  - Name, Email & Phone
  - Guest Count Only (records headcount without creating a guest contact)
- **Auto contact matching** — When guest details are collected, Kayan automatically creates or matches a contact using the provided email and/or phone number
- **Existing calendars** — No change; they continue collecting Name & Email by default
- **New calendars** — Default to Name, Email & Phone for richer records out of the box
- **Accurate guest timezones** — Guest contacts now inherit the primary contact's timezone instead of defaulting to the business timezone. If the guest already exists in your CRM, their timezone stays unchanged

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Go to your **Kayan dashboard** and open **Calendars**
2. Select the calendar you want to edit and open its settings
3. Navigate to the **Guest Settings** section
4. Choose your preferred guest detail fields from the available options
5. Save your changes — new bookings will reflect the updated configuration immediately

updates.title: 📈 Rebuilt Course Progress Analytics
updates.content:
**Rebuilt Course Progress Analytics** *(Coming Soon)*

A fully rebuilt analytics experience for your courses is on the way. Track how learners move through your content, spot drop-offs early, and get a clearer picture of engagement — all from one place.

**What's coming:**

- Unified analytics dashboard with filters by course and enrollment date
- Key metrics: Completion Rate, Average Progress, and Time to Complete — with period-over-period comparisons
- Learner Journey Funnel showing progression from Enrolled → Started → Completed
- Member Progress Table with enrollment, activity, completion, and session-level detail
- CSV export for filtered reports, with email delivery for larger data sets
- Significantly faster load times and a more responsive analytics experience

**Up next after launch:** Assessment Analytics and Revenue Analytics will follow to round out the full courses reporting suite.

updates.title: Email Events: Message ID Now Available in the Dynamic Picker
updates.content:
**Email Events: Message ID Now in the Dynamic Picker**

Email Events triggers now include a unique Message ID, so every open and click can be traced back to the exact email that generated it — no guesswork, no API workarounds.

**What's new**

- Message ID is now available as a custom value inside the Send Webhook action when your workflow starts with an Email Events trigger
- The ID is stable per message — repeat opens of the same email always send the same value
- Works for both Email Opened and Email Clicked events
- Late-arriving opens still carry the correct ID, pointing back to the original email regardless of timing

**Why it matters**

Previously, teams pushing email engagement data to external dashboards had no reliable way to deduplicate events. A contact opening the same email four times would generate four separate records with no shared identifier. Now, those events collapse cleanly against a single message, and opens from two different campaigns stay correctly separated — even when sent to the same contact in the same week.

**How to set it up**

1. In the Kayan Automations tab, open or create a workflow with **Email Events** as the trigger
2. Add a **Send Webhook** action to the workflow
3. When building the webhook payload, open the custom value picker
4. Select **Message ID** and insert it into the body
5. Save and publish — every open and click event will now include the Message ID in the outbound payload

updates.title: Fixed: 'Create/Update Record' Picklists Now Accept Dynamic Values
updates.content:
**Fix: Dynamic Values Now Work in Create/Update Record Dropdown Fields**

Dropdown fields in Create Record and Update Record actions were dropping saved dynamic values — opening blank with no selected option and no way to re-enter a merge tag. That's fixed.

**What's new**

- Single-select dropdown fields now include a **Standard / Dynamic toggle**, consistent with how the Update Contact Field action already works.
- **Standard mode** gives you the searchable picklist, including any image options.
- **Dynamic mode** gives you a free-text input with the custom value picker — use merge tags from triggers, formatters, or inbound webhooks.
- Fields with a saved value that doesn't match a picklist option will automatically open in Dynamic mode, so existing automation configs render correctly without any manual fixes.
- Switching between modes clears the current field value to prevent a stale value from the previous mode saving silently.

**What's not affected**

- Multi-select fields are unchanged.
- Update Contact Field already had this toggle and remains unchanged.

---

**How to set it up**

1. Open the **Kayan Automations** tab and select an automation that uses a Create Record or Update Record action.
2. Click into the action and find the dropdown field you want to populate dynamically.
3. Toggle the field from **Standard** to **Dynamic**.
4. Use the value picker to insert your merge tag (trigger field, formatter output, webhook value, etc.).
5. Save the action. Note: switching modes clears the field — re-enter your value after toggling.

Applies to Create Record, Update Record, and associated record actions in both contact-based and custom object automations.

updates.title: Fixed: Pinned and Recent Tabs Now Match the Workflow Type
updates.content:
**Pinned and Recent Actions Now Filter by Workflow Type**

The Pinned and Recent sections in the Automations sidebar were showing actions and triggers regardless of the workflow type you were editing. A Contact action used once could appear as a shortcut inside a Company or Custom Object workflow, where it doesn't belong.

**What's fixed**

- Pinned and Recent now only show actions and triggers that are valid for the workflow you currently have open
- Contact actions stay scoped to Contact workflows; Company actions to Company workflows; Custom Object actions to their respective workflows
- Shortcuts that would fail on selection are hidden automatically — no more broken clicks
- Your existing pins are untouched; they're simply hidden in workflows where they don't apply
- The full action and trigger list below these sections was already accurate and remains unchanged

**How to set it up**

No configuration needed — this is automatic.

1. Open the **Kayan Automations** tab and select any existing workflow, or create a new one
2. Click into the Actions & Triggers sidebar and check the **Pinned** or **Recent** sections
3. You'll only see shortcuts relevant to that workflow's type — anything that doesn't apply is hidden from view

updates.title: Rental Booking Page Gets Smarter CTAs, Clearer Checkout & Polished UI
updates.content:
**Rental Booking: Smarter CTAs, Clearer Checkout & UI Improvements**

The rental booking experience just got a meaningful upgrade — from the listing page through to checkout. These changes give you more control over button labeling, surface key booking details where they matter most, and clean up the overall flow for a more trustworthy experience.

**What's new:**

- **Custom "Add to Cart" button label** — When multi-item cart is enabled, you can now set a custom label for the add-to-cart button directly from your booking page settings. Defaults to "Add to cart" if left unchanged. Only appears when multi-cart is active, so single-item bookings are unaffected.
- **Rental dates shown throughout checkout** — Selected rental dates now appear in the Order Summary on the checkout page, giving customers clear confirmation they're booking the right dates before they complete payment.
- **Listing descriptions expanded by default** — Full descriptions are now shown inline on rental detail pages with no "Read more" click required. Mobile experience is improved as well.
- **Cart persistence when navigating** — Clicking the company logo to return to the homepage no longer clears an in-progress booking. The cart stays intact while browsing.
- **General UI polish** — Improved text wrapping on homepage listing cards, removal of a redundant single-quantity label from Booking Summary and Confirmation screens, and various minor fixes for a cleaner look.

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Global Settings** and open the **Booking Page** tab.
2. Enable **Multi-item cart** — this reveals the button label field.
3. Enter your preferred label text and save. The change reflects on your booking page immediately.

All other improvements are live automatically across all rental listings — no configuration needed.

updates.title: Goal Action: Now with Support for User Replies!
updates.content:
**Goal Action: Trigger on Team Member Reply**

Automations can now detect when a team member replies to a contact and use that as a Goal event — immediately halting or redirecting the automation the moment human engagement begins.

**What's new:**
- "User Replied" is now a supported Goal event inside Kayan Automations
- When a team member sends a reply through any connected conversation channel, the contact jumps directly to the Goal step — skipping all intermediate actions
- Prevents contacts from receiving automated follow-ups after a real conversation has started
- Works across nurture sequences, support workflows, and any automation where human handoff matters

**How to set it up:**
1. Open the **Kayan Automations** tab and select the workflow you want to update
2. Add a **Goal** action at the point where human engagement should take over
3. Set the goal event to **User Replied**
4. Configure any actions that should run once the Goal is reached (e.g. move to a pipeline stage, add a tag, end the sequence)
5. Save and publish the workflow

**Notes:**
- The Goal triggers only when a team member sends the reply — not the contact
- Contacts skip all steps between their current position and the Goal step instantly
- Best used at the end of nurture sequences or before any actions that would create duplicate outreach

updates.title: Wait Step: Now with Support for User Replies!
updates.content:
**Wait Step Now Supports User Reply as a Wait Condition**

The Wait step in Kayan Automations now supports "User Replied" as a wait condition — letting you pause a workflow until a team member responds to a conversation, not just until a contact replies.

**What's new:**
- New wait condition: pause workflow execution until a user (team member) sends a reply in the conversation
- Optional timeout setting — if no reply is sent within your defined window, the workflow moves forward automatically
- On timeout, route contacts through escalation logic: supervisor alerts, conversation reassignments, task creation, or reminders
- If a user replies before the timeout, the workflow resumes immediately
- Works without a timeout configured — workflow simply waits indefinitely until a user reply is detected

**How to set it up:**

1. Open your workflow in the Kayan Automations tab and add a **Wait** step at the point where a team member response is expected.
2. Set the wait condition to **User Replied**.
3. Optionally define a timeout duration (e.g. 15 or 30 minutes) to cap the wait window.
4. Configure the path for when a reply is received, then configure a separate path for when the timeout expires — add escalation actions like notifications, reassignments, or task creation on the timeout branch.
5. Save and publish your workflow.

**Good for:** first-response SLA enforcement, sales lead response tracking, support escalation workflows, and internal response-time automations.

updates.title: Workflow Trigger: User Replied
updates.content:
**New Trigger: User Replied**

Automate actions the moment a team member responds to a contact — no more waiting on customer activity to move things forward.

**What's new:**
- A new automation trigger fires whenever a team member sends a reply to a contact
- Works across supported conversation channels
- Supports trigger filters so you control exactly when the automation runs
- Pairs with any follow-up actions: tagging, stage updates, internal notifications, task creation, assignments, and more

**How to set it up:**
1. Go to the **Automations** tab in your Kayan dashboard and open or create a workflow
2. Add the **User Replied** trigger
3. Configure any filters to narrow when the workflow should fire
4. Publish the workflow — it will run automatically each time a team member sends a reply

**Example use cases:**
- A rep replies to a new lead's SMS → opportunity stage updates to *Contacted* and the sales manager gets notified
- A support agent replies to a customer email → a *Support Responded* tag is applied and a 48-hour follow-up task is created

**Note:** This trigger activates on team member replies only, not incoming customer messages. Use it to build automations that respond to what your team does, not just what your contacts do.

updates.title: 💳 Services (v2): Payment Enhancements
updates.content:
**Services Payments: More Flexibility at Checkout**

Checkout for bookable services now supports flexible payment options, smarter deposit calculations, and better Buy Now, Pay Later compatibility.

**What's new:**

- **Deposit or full payment choice** — You can now enable an option that lets customers choose at checkout whether to pay a deposit or the full amount. Requires online payments to be active and a deposit configured on the service.
- **BNPL on full amounts** — Customers using Buy Now, Pay Later can now finance the complete service cost, not just the deposit, for a smoother booking experience.
- **Smarter percentage-based deposits** — Deposit amounts are now calculated against the final payable amount after discounts, add-ons, and taxes are applied. If a coupon is added, removed, or changed during checkout, the deposit recalculates in real time.
- **Flat deposits unchanged** — Fixed deposit amounts continue to work exactly as before.

---

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Services → Settings → Payment Settings**.
2. Set the payment mode to **Online Payment**.
3. Toggle on **Allow Deposit or Full Payment Choice**.
4. Save your changes.

Once enabled, customers booking services with a deposit configured will see both payment options at checkout.

updates.title: 🗓️ Buffer Time is Now Visible in Calendar Day & Week Views
updates.content:
**Buffer Time Now Visible in Day & Week Calendar Views**

Pre- and post-buffer times are now displayed directly in your Day and Week calendar views, giving you a clearer picture of how your schedule is spaced without changing how bookings work.

**What's new:**
- Buffer periods appear as distinct visual blocks before and after appointments in both Day and Week views
- Buffers are clearly differentiated from actual appointments so your schedule is easy to read at a glance
- Visibility applies across all calendar filters — by staff member, service, or category/group

**How to set it up:**
1. Open the **Calendar** section in your Kayan dashboard
2. Switch to **Day** or **Week** view
3. Enable the **Show buffer time** toggle
4. Buffer periods will appear highlighted around your appointments across all active filters

updates.title: WhatsApp statistics in Workflows
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Message Statistics in Automations**

Track the full delivery lifecycle of your WhatsApp messages directly inside your automation — no need to jump between tools.

**What's new**

- **Full delivery tracking:** Monitor total sent, pending, delivered, read, and failed counts for any WhatsApp action inside an automation, using the same status data reported back by Meta.
- **Custom date ranges:** Filter statistics by a specific time window to evaluate performance for a particular campaign or send period.
- **Message-level detail:** Open any individual message to view recipient information and precise delivery timestamps.
- **Export:** Download your statistics for external analysis or reporting.
- **Live refresh:** Update message statuses on demand with a refresh button — no full page reload required.

**How to set it up**

1. Open the **Kayan Automations** tab and select the automation containing a WhatsApp action.
2. Click on the WhatsApp action, then select **Statistics**.
3. Use the date range selector to define your reporting window.
4. Click into any individual message to view recipient and timestamp details.
5. Select **Open All Statistics**, then click **Export** to download the data.

WhatsApp delivery isn't guaranteed — messages can sit pending, fail, or go unread. Having delivered, read, and failed counts surfaced at the automation level means you can catch delivery drops or failure spikes at the source and export the detail when you need to investigate or report.

updates.title: WhatsApp: AI template generator (compliant, on-brand, fast)
updates.content:
**WhatsApp: AI Template Generator**

Generate compliant, ready-to-submit WhatsApp message templates from a plain description — no field-by-field building required.

**What's new**

- **AI drafting from a description:** Describe your use case and audience (e.g. "payment reminder for retail customers") and the AI drafts a complete template with personalisation variables already in place.
- **Auto-categorisation:** The AI classifies each draft as Utility, Marketing, or Authentication — aligned with Meta's own categories — so your template is set up correctly before it ever reaches review.
- **Inline validation:** Get real-time recommendations on length, formatting, and policy fit as you draft, catching issues before submission rather than after a rejection.
- **Fully editable before submit:** Adjust copy, variables, and CTAs however you need, then submit to Meta for approval when it's ready.

**Why it matters**

Meta applies different rules by template category — Utility templates, for example, aren't subject to the same per-user frequency limits as Marketing templates. Getting categorisation and formatting right up front means fewer rejections and no surprises at send time.

**How to set it up**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **WhatsApp → Templates** and select **Create Template → AI Template**.
2. Enter a description of your use case and target audience.
3. Review the AI-generated draft, its assigned category, and any validation hints.
4. Edit copy, variables, or CTAs as needed.
5. Submit to Meta for approval.

updates.title: WhatsApp template management: a full UX revamp
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Template Management: Full UX Overhaul**

Managing WhatsApp templates at scale just got significantly easier. The entire template and folder experience has been rebuilt — faster navigation, real folder structure, filtering, sorting, and flexible reorganization, all in a cleaner interface.

**What's new**

- **One-click refresh** — Update your template list and approval statuses in place without reloading the page. You stay exactly where you are.
- **Real folder navigation** — Open a folder and work inside it like a true directory. Templates and subfolders are scoped to the folder you're in, so nested organization is finally practical.
- **Template location visibility** — The templates list now shows which folder each template lives in, so your library structure is always clear at a glance.
- **Filters** — Narrow templates by Status, Language, Last Edited, and Category. No more scrolling through hundreds of templates to find the right one.
- **Sorting** — Order your list by Template Name, Language, Category, Last Edited, or Status.
- **Flexible reorganization** — Move templates between folders, nest folders inside others, or pull them back up to a parent level. Restructure freely as your needs change.
- **Refreshed interface** — Both the templates and folders screens have been rebuilt to match current design standards — cleaner, faster, more structured.

**How to set it up**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Messaging → WhatsApp Templates**.
2. Use the new **filter and sort controls** at the top of the template list to narrow or reorder your view.
3. Click into any folder to enter it directly and see only its contents.
4. To move a template or folder, select it and use the **Move** option to place it wherever it belongs.
5. Hit the **Refresh** button anytime to pull the latest Meta approval statuses without leaving your current view.

updates.title: WhatsApp Templates: Cleaner Selection, RTL Authoring, and Compliance Visibility
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Templates: Cleaner Selection, RTL Authoring, and Compliance Visibility**

WhatsApp template management in Kayan is now more reliable and transparent — fewer failed sends, faster pickers, and native right-to-left authoring built directly into your workflow.

**What's new**

- **Approved templates only:** Every template dropdown — in Conversations, Bulk Actions, and Automation WhatsApp steps — now shows only approved templates. You'll no longer be able to select a template that would silently fail at send time.
- **Faster template loading:** Dropdowns fetch only the data they need, so template pickers load quicker across all screens, including heavier, data-intensive views.
- **Native RTL authoring:** Create and edit Arabic, Urdu, and Hebrew templates directly in Kayan's template editor. No more drafting externally and pasting in. Works alongside the AI template generator for faster RTL creation.
- **Compliance visibility:** Meta compliance issues are surfaced before a send fails, so you know what's blocking a template before it causes a problem.
- **Phone Numbers tab fixes:** The WhatsApp Phone Numbers tab now scrolls cleanly and paginates correctly — no more overflow issues on smaller screens or long lists.

**How to set it up**

1. Go to **Kayan dashboard → Messaging → WhatsApp Templates**.
2. Open any existing template or create a new one — RTL language input is supported directly in the text fields.
3. When building automations, open the **Kayan Automations tab**, add a WhatsApp action, and open the template picker — only approved templates will appear.
4. Check the **Phone Numbers** tab to review connected numbers with the improved scroll and pagination.

No configuration required. All changes are live across your existing workflows and send surfaces.

updates.title: Smarter, Customizable Profile & Business Cards
updates.content:
**Smarter, Customizable Profile & Business Cards**

Your digital business card just got a significant upgrade — modernized designs, deeper personalization, and built-in tools to capture and track leads automatically.

**What's New**

- **Refreshed card designs** — Profile and Business Cards have a cleaner, more professional look out of the box
- **Default "Save Contact" button** — visitors can save your contact info to their device in one tap, no extra setup required
- **Cover images** — upload your own or choose from pre-designed templates
- **Custom color palette** — control background, text, icons, buttons, and button text individually
- **Minimalist view toggle** — hide icon labels for a cleaner card layout
- **Custom links** — add websites, booking links, portfolios, social profiles, or landing pages, each with an assigned icon via the built-in Icon Picker
- **Exchange Contact forms** — collect visitor info directly from your card using a new or existing form; submissions automatically create a new contact in your CRM with the lead source logged
- **Editable CTA text** — rename the contact exchange button to match your brand
- **Smart automation toggles** — optionally auto-display the contact form on card open, or auto-download your contact info to the visitor's device on arrival

---

**How to set it up**

1. Open the **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to **QR Code Builder**
2. Select or create a Profile or Business Card
3. Apply your cover image, color palette, and toggle minimalist view if preferred
4. Add custom links and assign icons using the Icon Picker
5. Configure your Exchange Contact form — build a new one or select an existing form
6. Set your CTA button text and enable any automation toggles you want
7. Publish and share your updated card

> **Note:** Existing Profile and Business Cards won't update automatically — you'll need to open each one and apply the new settings manually.

updates.title: Ad Manager: Opportunity Score for Meta Campaigns
updates.content:
**Ad Manager: Opportunity Score for Meta Campaigns**

Before you publish a Meta ad campaign, Kayan now shows you an Opportunity Score — a readiness rating that flags setup gaps and points you directly to where you can fix them.

**What's new:**

- **Pre-publish readiness score** — See a percentage score (rated Low, Medium, or High) on the campaign Review screen before going live
- **Improvement suggestions across four areas:**
  - *Audience* — flags if targeting is too narrow, too broad, or incomplete
  - *Budget* — identifies if spend settings may limit delivery or learning
  - *Creative* — reviews ad content, media, CTAs, and destination links
  - *Tracking* — checks whether conversion tracking is configured
- **Click-to-fix navigation** — each recommendation links directly to the relevant section of the campaign builder so you can make updates without hunting through settings
- **Prioritised guidance** — the score panel surfaces the highest-impact fixes first

**A few things to note:**
- Opportunity Score is currently available for Meta campaigns only
- It's a guidance tool — it does not guarantee performance or make changes automatically
- You decide which recommendations to act on

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open **Ad Manager** in your Kayan dashboard and create or edit a Meta campaign
2. Complete your campaign setup
3. Proceed to the **Review** screen
4. Check your **Opportunity Score** in the score panel
5. Review the suggestions listed and click any recommendation to jump directly to that section
6. Make your updates, return to the Review screen, and publish when ready

updates.title: 📲 SMS Notifications Now Available for Rentals
updates.content:
**SMS Notifications Now Available for Rental Bookings**

You can now send SMS notifications for rental bookings directly from Kayan. Set up confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups that reach contacts and your team in real time — no manual outreach needed.

**What's new:**
- SMS support across all rental booking events: unconfirmed, booked, canceled, rescheduled, reminder, and follow-up
- Choose recipients per notification — send to the contact, your business, or both
- Set separate SMS templates for contacts vs. your business so each party gets the right message
- Default templates included for every notification type, with full customization options or the ability to pull from existing templates in your account
- Test any SMS before it goes live using the built-in Send Test SMS option

**How to set it up:**
1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Calendar Settings → Rentals → Global Settings → Notifications**
2. Select a notification type and open the **SMS tab**, then toggle SMS on
3. Choose your recipients (Contact, Business, or both)
4. Select or customize your SMS template
5. Send a test SMS to confirm the message looks right
6. Save — SMS will fire automatically when that event is triggered

updates.title: 💬 WhatsApp Notifications Are Here for Rentals
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Notifications Now Available for Rentals**

You can now send WhatsApp messages as part of your Rentals notification workflow — giving clients and your team a direct, mobile-first communication channel they're already using.

**What's new:**

- WhatsApp is supported across all rental event types: Unconfirmed, Booked, Canceled, Rescheduled, Reminder, and Follow-up
- Toggle WhatsApp on or off per individual notification type
- Choose recipients separately — send to Contacts, your Business, or both
- Set different WhatsApp templates per recipient type for full message control
- Each notification comes with a default template; keep it, select an existing approved template, or build a new one using the in-app template builder
- Refresh your available templates in real time with a single click
- Preview any message before it goes live using the test notification option

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Calendar Settings → Rentals → Global Settings → Notifications**
2. Under each notification type, toggle **WhatsApp** on
3. Select your recipients (Contacts, Business, or both)
4. Choose an approved WhatsApp template or create a new one using the template builder
5. Send a test message to confirm it looks right
6. Save — WhatsApp messages will now send automatically based on booking activity

updates.title: Prospecting: Smarter CRM contact creation & contact enrichment
updates.content:
**Prospecting: Smarter Contact Creation & Enrichment**

Kayan's Prospecting tool now creates richer, cleaner CRM contacts the moment you add a prospect — no manual cleanup required, and ready for outreach or automation from day one.

**What's new:**

- **Website-based enrichment** — Kayan now scrapes phone numbers and emails directly from a prospect's website, going beyond basic directory data so your CRM records start more complete
- **Fuller contact records by default** — Every new prospect contact now includes source tagging, prospect tags for segmentation, phone and email fields (including additional numbers/addresses), website URL, and full address details
- **Control over decision-maker contacts** — A new enrichment setting lets you choose whether Kayan should search for additional Points of Contact (POCs) like owners, managers, or key decision-makers. When enabled, each POC is created as its own CRM contact. When disabled, only the primary business contact is created — faster and cleaner for simpler workflows
- **No more duplicate business contacts** — Additional phone numbers and emails are now consolidated onto a single primary business contact rather than generating separate duplicate records. POCs are still created individually when found

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to the **Prospecting** section
2. Go to **Prospecting Settings** and locate the **Contact Enrichment** options
3. Toggle **POC search** on or off depending on whether you want decision-maker contacts created automatically
4. Run or re-run a prospect search — new contacts will be created with the enriched fields applied automatically
5. Find all created contacts in your **CRM tab**, filterable by the "Prospecting" source tag

updates.title: AI Studio Form Submitted Workflow Trigger
updates.content:
**AI Studio Form Submitted — Workflow Trigger**

Automate follow-up the moment a visitor submits a form on your AI Studio site. This new trigger connects AI Studio form submissions directly to Kayan Automations, so you can act on leads instantly without manual steps.

**What's new:**
- New "AI Studio Form Submitted" trigger available in Kayan Automations
- Automatically starts a workflow when a connected AI Studio form is submitted
- Supports any follow-up action: notifications, emails, SMS, tags, opportunity creation, and more
- Works alongside existing external tracking — no disruption to current setups

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan Automations** tab and create or edit a workflow
2. Add the **AI Studio Form Submitted** trigger
3. Connect your desired follow-up actions (email, SMS, tag, etc.)
4. Save and publish the workflow

**If your form was connected before this update**, you'll need to refresh the tracking setup:
1. Open the relevant AI Studio project
2. Prompt AI Studio: *"Re-trigger form integration"*
3. Reconnect the form to CRM tracking
4. Publish the project
5. Submit a test entry, then return to the workflow builder to confirm the trigger is firing correctly

updates.title: Prompt Optimizer for Conversations AI - Test, Tune, and Launch Better Chat Agents
updates.content:
**Prompt Optimizer for Chat Agents — Test, Tune, and Deploy with Confidence**

Before your chat agent goes live with real customers, now you can verify it actually performs the way you intend. Prompt Optimizer now supports Kayan's Conversations AI agents — running real test conversations, scoring results, and rewriting underperforming prompts, all without touching your live agent.

**What's new:**

- **Auto-generated test scenarios** — Kayan generates realistic customer personas, opening messages, expected behaviors, and priority levels based on your agent's prompt, language, knowledge base, and configured actions
- **Real conversations, not simulations** — the optimizer sends actual customer-style messages to a cloned copy of your agent and captures real replies
- **Action tracking** — see exactly when your agent triggers appointment booking, human handover, workflow actions, bot transfers, contact field updates, and knowledge base queries
- **Full transcripts with AI scoring** — every conversation is evaluated against expected outcomes with clear pass/fail reasoning
- **One-click Improvise** — AI identifies what failed, rewrites the prompt, and retests automatically
- **Auto Optimize** — runs multiple optimization rounds until a target accuracy threshold is reached
- **Prompt diff viewer** — review exactly what changed between versions before applying anything
- **Best Variation tag** — the highest-accuracy prompt is flagged, with full attempt history saved
- **Runs in the background** — start a test run and return when results are ready
- **Clean CRM** — temporary test contacts are created per run and automatically removed when complete
- **Multi-language support** — scenarios, evaluations, and optimized prompts stay aligned to your agent's configured language

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, open the Chat Agents section and select the agent you want to test
2. Navigate to the **Prompt Optimizer** tab within that agent's settings
3. Review the pre-run checklist — confirm your test calendars and workflows are in place, since real actions execute during testing
4. Choose to auto-generate new scenarios or load scenarios from a previous run
5. Start the test — the optimizer will run conversations against a cloned version of your agent; your live agent remains unchanged
6. Review transcripts, scores, and the prompt diff once the run completes
7. When satisfied with a variation, click **Use Prompt** to apply it to your live agent

> **Note:** Accuracy scores are directional — expect some variation between runs. Always use dedicated test calendars and workflows to avoid unintended bookings or workflow triggers during optimization.

updates.title: 💬Threads Comment Management: Now Available in Social Planner
updates.content:
**Threads Comment Management Now Available in Social Planner**

You can now manage Threads comments directly inside Kayan's Social Planner — no platform switching required. View, reply to, and track Threads conversations from the same unified inbox you use for all your other social channels.

**What's new**

- **Threads added to the unified inbox** — Threads now sits alongside Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Communities, and Bluesky in a single comment management view
- **Full reply support** — respond to Threads comments with text, images, emojis, and location attachments
- **Real-time sync** — comments update via webhooks so you're always seeing the latest activity
- **No workflow interruptions** — everything lives inside Social Planner; no need to leave Kayan to stay on top of Threads engagement

**How to set it up**

1. In the Kayan dashboard, go to **Marketing → Social Planner → Comment Management**
2. Select your connected Threads account
3. Open the **Comments** tab to view and reply to comments from the unified inbox

> **Note:** Existing Threads users will need to reconnect their account once to grant the additional permissions required for Comment Management.

updates.title: Email AI – Smart Countdown Timer Creation and Suggestions
updates.content:
**Email AI: Smart Countdown Timer Creation and Suggestions**

Kayan's Email AI now detects when an email calls for a countdown timer and guides you through adding one — no manual setup required.

**What's new:**
- Email AI identifies time-sensitive emails (flash sales, product launches, webinars, expiring offers) and suggests a countdown timer only when relevant
- Choose from an existing timer or create a new one directly within the AI flow
- When creating a new timer, AI collects the end date, style, and destination link automatically
- The selected timer is embedded into your email template on the spot
- If you skip the timer prompt, the AI continues without interruption — no dead ends

**How to set it up:**
1. Open the **Email Builder** from your Kayan dashboard and start a new template or edit an existing one
2. Activate **Email AI** to generate or update your layout
3. If your email content is time-sensitive, AI will prompt you to add a countdown timer — select an existing one or choose to create new
4. Provide the end date, preferred style, and a destination link when creating a new timer
5. Confirm, and the timer is embedded directly into your email — ready to send

updates.title: WhatsApp template builder now catches invalid variables before you save
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Template Builder Now Catches Variable Errors Before You Save**

The WhatsApp template builder in Kayan now validates your variable placeholders in real time as you type — so mistakes are flagged immediately, not after a submission gets rejected.

**What's new**

- **Start/end variable check:** WhatsApp rejects message bodies that begin or end with a variable. The builder now flags this and blocks saving until there's surrounding text.
- **Invalid variable detection in headers and body:** Only numbered placeholders like `{{1}}`, `{{2}}` are valid. Malformed tokens like `{{1$}}` or unbalanced braces are caught instantly, with clear guidance on the correct format.
- **Reputation review-request preset fixed:** The default reputation template previously ended with a trailing variable, causing automatic rejection. It's been corrected so new reputation templates pass validation out of the box.

**How to set it up**

Nothing to enable — validation is built directly into the template builder.

1. Go to your **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to **Settings → WhatsApp → Templates**.
2. Open or create a template.
3. As you type, any invalid variables are flagged inline before you can save.

That's it. Errors surface immediately so your templates go live on the first attempt.

updates.title: Request contact info: collect phone numbers from WhatsApp username adopters
updates.content:
**Collect Phone Numbers from WhatsApp Username Contacts**

Some WhatsApp users have switched to usernames instead of visible phone numbers. When they message you, you receive their username only — no phone number, no way to call them, export them, or run phone-based automations. You can now send a one-tap "Share contact info" request that recovers their number and turns them into a fully usable contact.

---

**What's new**

- **Share contact info button on templates:** Add a contact-sharing button to utility or marketing WhatsApp templates. When the contact taps it, their phone number is captured automatically on their record.
- **Workflow action for contact info requests:** Trigger the same request from inside a Kayan Automation, so the ask goes out at exactly the right moment — no manual follow-up needed.
- **Duplicate-safe capture:** If a phone number already exists on another contact, it won't be added again. Recovering numbers at scale stays clean.
- **WhatsApp calling for username contacts:** Contacts using usernames are now supported in WhatsApp calling flows, so they no longer fall out of your call sequences.

---

**How to set it up**

1. Go to **Settings → WhatsApp → Templates** in your Kayan dashboard.
2. Create or edit a template. Under **Button (Optional)**, select **Share contact info**.
3. To automate it, open the **Kayan Automations** tab, add a new action, and choose **WhatsApp Interactive Message**. Set the message type to **Request Contact Info** and write your message body.
4. Save and activate — the number is captured the moment the contact taps.

updates.title: Chat Widget: Flexible Compliance Notice & Consent Settings
updates.content:
**Chat Widget: Flexible Compliance & Consent Settings**

You now have independent control over legal notices and visitor consent in your chat widget — no longer bundled into a single setting.

**What's new:**

- Display a legal notice below the contact form with no action required from the visitor
- Add a consent checkbox with fully custom wording (e.g. SMS or email marketing opt-in)
- Set consent as required or optional depending on your compliance needs
- Pre-check the consent checkbox when the form loads
- Show inline validation ("Please tick this box to continue.") when required consent is missing
- Track consent in Activity details — including whether it was given, whether it was required, and the exact text shown

**How to set it up:**

1. Go to your Kayan dashboard and open the **Chat Widget** builder
2. Select your widget, then navigate to **Chat Window → Additional Options → Compliance Notice & Consent**
3. Configure your legal notice text, consent checkbox wording, required/optional behavior, and pre-checked state
4. Use the live preview to confirm the experience before saving

**A few things to note:**

- Available to all accounts
- Existing widgets are unchanged until you open and save them in the builder
- Any existing legal text carries over automatically to the correct field
- No changes to your website embed code are needed

updates.title: Offer multiple meeting durations within a single calendar
updates.content:
**Offer Multiple Meeting Durations on a Single Calendar**

Bookers can now choose their preferred meeting length directly from your booking page — no need to maintain separate calendars for different durations.

**What's new:**

- Configure up to 3 duration options on a single calendar
- Set a default duration for new bookings
- Add or remove duration options at any time without affecting existing appointments
- Availability refreshes automatically when a booker selects a different duration
- Duration selection is supported during rescheduling — bookers can change the meeting length alongside the date and time
- Works across web and mobile booking pages, booking widgets, and in-app appointment booking
- Supported on Personal, Round Robin, Collective, and Event calendars

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to your **Calendars** section
2. Select the calendar you want to update and open its settings
3. Find the **Duration Options** setting and add up to 3 time options
4. Mark one duration as the default
5. Save your changes — the booking page will update immediately

Existing appointments are never modified when you change duration options. Any already-booked meetings retain their original length, reminders, and notifications.

updates.title: Workflow Builder: Array/List Values Now Supported in Text Fields
updates.content:
**Automation Builder: List & Array Values Now Supported in Text Fields**

You can now insert list-type data — like order line items, webhook arrays, or any multi-value collection — directly into text fields within your automations, with full control over how that list is displayed.

**What's new:**
- The value picker now recognizes list-type variables and opens an inline formatting panel instead of dumping raw data into your field
- Choose which field to extract from the list (e.g. a SKU, name, or price field)
- Select your preferred display format: comma-separated, bulleted, numbered, or a custom separator
- Set an optional fallback for when the list is empty
- Preview the output before inserting it
- Formatting rules are saved with the variable and re-rendered live each time the automation runs
- Single-value variables (text, number, date, etc.) are unaffected — they still insert instantly as before

**How to set it up:**

1. Open your automation in the Kayan Automations tab and navigate to any text field (e.g. an email body, internal note, or message action)
2. Open the value picker and select a list-type variable from your available data sources
3. In the inline panel that appears, choose the field to extract from the list and your preferred format
4. Optionally define a fallback value if the list is empty
5. Check the preview, then click **Insert** to place the formatted list at your cursor

updates.title: Workflow Dynamic Values: New Chip Interface with Quick Add and Edit
updates.content:
**Automation Text Fields Now Show Dynamic Values as Chips**

Dynamic values in automation text fields now display as visual chips, making it easier to distinguish them from static text at a glance. Invalid or unrecognized values are flagged in red so you can catch and fix issues before your automation runs.

**What's new:**
- Dynamic values render as chips inside automation text fields for clear visual separation from static content
- Type `/` anywhere in a text field to search and insert a dynamic value without leaving your cursor
- Click an existing chip to swap it out with a different value in the same position
- Stale or unrecognized values are highlighted in red, making them easy to spot and correct
- No change to how values are resolved or how your automations behave — this is a visual update only

**How to set it up:**
1. Open any automation in the **Kayan Automations** tab and select an action with a text field
2. Type `/` inside the text field to pull up the dynamic value search and select the value you want to insert
3. To replace an existing value, click its chip and choose a new one from the list
4. If any values appear in red, click them and select a valid replacement — red chips indicate values that are no longer recognized and should be updated before the automation goes live

updates.title: WhatsApp: composer reliability and faster Settings
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Composer & Settings: Reliability Fixes**

The WhatsApp conversation composer and Settings page now load correctly on the first attempt — no more false prompts or blank screens requiring repeated refreshes.

**What's new**

- **No more false "Connect WhatsApp" prompt** — After the 24-hour messaging window closes, the composer was incorrectly showing a reconnect prompt even on fully connected accounts, blocking template sends. It now reads connection status correctly before rendering, so the template send path appears as expected.
- **WhatsApp Settings loads on first open** — The WhatsApp Settings tab no longer gets stuck on a blank or perpetual loading state. It renders immediately without requiring a manual refresh.
- **Noticeably faster Settings load** — Page load performance has improved significantly: Speed Index dropped from 13.2s to 4.3s, and First Contentful Paint from 3.8s to 1.0s.

**How to set it up**

No configuration needed — these fixes are live automatically.

1. Open the **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to a WhatsApp conversation.
2. Confirm the composer shows the correct send options without prompting you to reconnect.
3. Go to **Settings → WhatsApp** to verify the page loads fully on first open.

If a connected account still shows an unexpected reconnect prompt, a hard refresh will resolve it. No re-authentication required.

updates.title: QR Codes — Save to Apple & Google Wallet
updates.content:
**QR Codes Now Save to Apple & Google Wallet**

Your QR codes can now be saved directly to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet — no more digging through a camera roll to find the right one during in-person interactions.

**What's new:**

- **Save to digital wallet** — Add any QR code to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet directly from the Kayan dashboard
- **Fast offline access** — Open your wallet, pull up the right QR code, and let a customer scan it in seconds
- **Contextual pass details** — Each wallet pass displays relevant information (QR type, destination, associated location) so you always know what you're presenting
- **Wallet-native designs** — Pass layouts are optimized for each platform; Apple Wallet and Google Wallet each render passes according to their own supported configurations, so expect some visual differences between the two
- **Works with existing QR codes** — No need to recreate anything; all previously built QR codes are eligible
- **Brand attribution** — Your brand appears in the wallet pass header by default; an option to make this configurable is planned for a future update

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Go to the **QR Code Builder** in your Kayan dashboard
2. Create a new QR code or open an existing one and navigate to the final step of the builder
3. Select **Add to Digital Wallet**
4. A new QR code will appear on screen — scan it with your phone
5. Your device will automatically add the pass to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet based on your OS
6. Open your wallet when needed, select the relevant pass, and present it for scanning

updates.title: ✨ Ask AI Mobile App - Schedule Ask AI prompts to run automatically
updates.content:
**Schedule Your AI Assistant to Run Automatically — Mobile**

The Kayan AI Scheduler lets you set any prompt once and have it run on a recurring basis — no manual input required. Open the app and your results are already waiting.

**What's new:**

- **Five scheduling frequencies:** Manual (on-demand), Hourly, Daily, Weekdays, and Weekly with your choice of day and time
- **Full task management:** Create, edit, pause, resume, and delete scheduled tasks directly from your phone
- **Run now:** Trigger any task instantly — including paused ones — and see the result land in run history immediately
- **Run history per task:** Every run logged with Completed / Skipped / Failed status, timestamps, and unread indicators for results you haven't opened yet
- **Open the conversation:** Tap any completed run to open the full AI chat session, exactly as if you'd asked it yourself
- **Organised chat history:** Scheduled runs appear in their own dedicated section, separate from your recent conversations — automated results never bury your active chats
- **Fully cross-platform:** Tasks created on mobile appear on the Kayan web dashboard and vice versa, with shared run history across both

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Ask AI** section in the Kayan mobile app and tap the **recurring-clock icon** in the header
2. Tap **+ New task**, give it a name, add the prompt you want to run, and choose a frequency — Manual, Hourly, Daily, Weekdays, or Weekly
3. Set your preferred time (and day, if Weekly), then save the task
4. From the task view, you can pause, resume, edit, delete, or tap **Run now** at any time — tap any completed run to open the full conversation

**Requires app version 4.22.0 or higher. Available on iOS and Android.**

updates.title: Custom Fields Grouping & Bulk Management - Forms, Surveys & Quizzes
updates.content:
**Custom Fields Grouping & Bulk Management — Forms, Surveys & Quizzes**

Building long forms with dozens of fields just got a lot faster. The Custom Fields sidebar in the Kayan form builder has been fully redesigned to support multi-select, bulk insertion, and group drag-and-drop — across Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes.

**What's New**

- **Multi-select checkboxes** on every field row so you can queue up multiple fields at once
- **"Add N fields" button** to insert your entire selection onto the canvas in one click
- **Multi-field drag & drop** — drag a group of selected fields with a stacked preview and a badge showing how many are in motion
- **Smart insertion point** — bulk-added fields land directly after the currently active canvas element, not just at the end
- **Object dropdown** to filter fields by Contact, Opportunity, Business, or any custom object
- **Tooltips on truncated field names** — hover to see the full name or query key
- Selections persist while you scroll and search, so you can build a batch across multiple folders
- Switching objects clears the current selection automatically — no stale counts
- Shift-click selects a range, automatically skipping fields already placed on the canvas
- One-question-per-slide (Survey) is respected — bulk-inserted fields split onto their own slides where needed
- Works identically across Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes

**How to set it up**

1. Open any Form, Survey, or Quiz in the Kayan dashboard builder.
2. In the left sidebar, switch to the **Object Fields** tab.
3. Use the object dropdown to select **Contact, Opportunity, Business**, or a custom object.
4. Search by field name or browse folders to find what you need.
5. Check the fields you want to add using the checkboxes on each row.
6. Either click **"Add N fields"** at the bottom of the sidebar, or drag any selected field onto the canvas — all checked fields move together as a group.
7. Fields land on the canvas in sidebar order, immediately after your active element.

updates.title: Upload Google Demand Gen Campaigns to Template Library
updates.content:
**Save Google Demand Gen Campaigns as Reusable Templates**

You can now upload Google Demand Gen campaigns directly to the Template Library — no rebuilding from scratch when you need to replicate a proven setup across locations.

**What's new:**
- Template Library upload is now supported for Google Demand Gen campaigns
- Upload any existing campaign directly from its action menu
- Uploaded campaigns are saved as Draft templates first, giving you a chance to review and edit before publishing
- Published templates are available for reuse across any location

**How to set it up:**
1. Go to **Ads Manager** in your Kayan dashboard and open the **Campaigns** tab
2. Find the Google Demand Gen campaign you want to save as a template
3. Click the **⋮** menu on that campaign
4. Select **Upload to Template Library**
5. Enter a template name and assign a category
6. Confirm the upload — it will appear in your Template Library as a Draft
7. Review the draft, make any edits, and publish it when ready

**Notes:**
- Templates are always created as Drafts first — nothing goes live until you publish
- Your existing Template Library workflows are unchanged
- This update applies specifically to Google Demand Gen campaigns

updates.title: Communities - Editor & Community Experience Enhancements ✏️
updates.content:
**Communities: Editor & Moderation Enhancements**

Creating content, moderating discussions, and managing recordings in Kayan Communities just got faster and more intuitive across the board.

**What's New**

- **Floating Rich Text Toolbar** — Select any text in a post to reveal a formatting toolbar. Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough, and link insertion are all available inline, no need to hunt through menus.
- **Ban Users Directly from Posts** — Open the three-dot menu (⋮) on any post to ban a spammer on the spot. You can optionally delete all of their content before confirming — no more navigating away to the Members section.
- **Download Recordings from Posts** — Open the three-dot menu (⋮) on a recording post and select Download Recording to save it instantly.
- **Updated Comment Editor Shortcuts** — Enter creates a new paragraph, Shift + Enter adds a new line within the same paragraph, and Ctrl + Enter (or clicking Post) publishes the comment.

---

**How to set it up**

These enhancements are active automatically — no configuration needed.

1. Go to **Communities** in your Kayan dashboard.
2. Open any community and start a post to access the floating formatting toolbar when selecting text.
3. To moderate, open the ⋮ menu on any post and select **Ban User**.
4. To download a recording, open the ⋮ menu on a recording post and select **Download Recording**.

updates.title: Private by default: Enhanced privacy controls for documents uploaded through notes
updates.content:
**Documents uploaded via Notes are now private by default**

Note attachments are now stored privately from the moment they're uploaded, giving you tighter control over sensitive documents without any extra steps.

**What's new:**
- New attachments added through the Notes section are private by default and stored in the "Notes Attachments" folder within Documents
- When sharing a document, you can choose the access level that fits your needs: public link, private link, OTP-protected link, or password-protected link
- Existing note attachments are not affected — they retain their current access status
- For existing documents that need tighter controls, you can manually generate a private or protected link at any time

**How to set it up:**

1. Open any contact record in your Kayan dashboard and navigate to the **Notes** section
2. Upload a document as an attachment — it will automatically be saved as private
3. To share it, open the file from the **Documents** tab under the "Notes Attachments" folder
4. Select your preferred sharing method: public, private, OTP-protected, or password-protected
5. For any older attachments, open the file and generate a private link manually if additional access control is needed

> **Coming next:** These privacy controls will extend to document attachments shared through custom fields for a consistent, secure experience across the platform.

updates.title: 🎟️ Events Beta is Now Available in Labs for Everyone
updates.content:
**🎟️ Events Management — Coming to Kayan.ai**

A full event management suite is on its way to Kayan.ai. From creating and promoting events to selling tickets, managing attendees, and triggering automations — the entire event lifecycle will be handled inside your Kayan dashboard.

**What's coming:**

- **Event creation & management** — Build free, paid, RSVP, in-person, online, and hybrid events. Manage details, schedules, speakers, and registrations all in one place.
- **Branded event pages** — Fully customizable registration and event detail pages with custom layouts, styling, and CSS support. Embeddable inside Kayan funnels or any external site.
- **Ticketing & registration** — Multiple ticket types, pricing tiers, inventory controls, coupon codes, add-ons, and per-attendee data collection. Manual attendee entry and payment recording included.
- **QR code tickets & check-in** — Automatic QR ticket issuance after registration. Scan and check in attendees via the Kayan mobile app with live attendance tracking.
- **Automation triggers** — Fire workflows when attendees register or check in. Build timed sequences before and after events — confirmations, reminders, follow-ups, and full CRM journeys.

This feature is currently in beta and not yet available. Once it rolls out, you'll be able to enable it directly from your Kayan dashboard settings. More details to come.

updates.title: Custom values support in dashboards and reporting
updates.content:
**Custom Values Now Supported in Dashboards and Reports**

You can now insert dynamic tokens into dashboard widgets and elements — build one dashboard template and let it adapt automatically for every client or location.

**What's new:**
- Use the `{}` picker to insert tokens into widget conditions (e.g. Source field) and dashboard elements (Embed URL, Title, Text box)
- **Location tokens available:** Location ID, Name, Email, Phone, Website, Address, City, State, Country, Postal Code, Timezone
- **User tokens available:** User ID, Email, Phone, Role, Type, First Name, Last Name, Full Name
- **Custom tokens:** Any custom values you've created under Settings → Custom Values are available in the picker, organised by folder
- Tokens resolve automatically per account when the dashboard is viewed — no manual duplication needed

**How to set it up:**
1. Open a dashboard in your Kayan dashboard and enter **Edit mode**
2. Add or edit a widget and go to its **Conditions** tab — or add an Element (Embed, Title, or Text box)
3. Click the **`{}`** button next to any text input field
4. Browse or search Location, User, or Custom value tokens
5. Select a token — it inserts automatically (e.g. `{{ location.name }}`)
6. Save and switch to **View mode** — the token resolves to the real value for that account

**Notes:**
- Token insertion is available to dashboard editors only
- If a token has no value set for a given account, it resolves as blank in view mode
- Location and User tokens are available by default; custom tokens require prior setup under Settings → Custom Values

updates.title: Add Ecommerce Stores Directly to Funnels
updates.content:
**Embed a Full Store Experience Inside Your Funnels**

You can now add a complete ecommerce store directly into any funnel — combining product browsing, cart, checkout, and order confirmation into a single, seamless flow.

**What's new:**
- Adding a store to a funnel automatically generates 5 linked steps: Product List, Product Details, Cart, Checkout, and Thank You
- Store elements (Featured Product, Upsell, Collection List, Search Bar, and more) can be added to any funnel step — doing so converts the funnel into a store-embedded funnel and creates the 5 required steps automatically
- A new **Store Products tab** appears on converted funnels, letting you control which products are visible and adjust their display priority
- Converted funnels are tagged for easy identification across your funnels and stores lists

**Things to know:**
- The 5 store steps maintain a fixed internal order but can be repositioned as a group relative to other funnel steps
- Only one store can be embedded per funnel
- Cloning a funnel carries over the store setup and steps — products themselves are not duplicated
- Deleting any one of the 5 store steps removes all of them and disables the store for that funnel
- Clone Step and A/B split testing are not supported on store steps

**How to set it up:**
1. Open a funnel in your Kayan dashboard and navigate to the funnel editor
2. Add a store from the Store section in the sidebar, or drop a Store element onto any existing funnel step
3. Select a theme and complete the store configuration when prompted
4. Use the **Store Products tab** on the step list page to manage product visibility and ordering
5. Customize the generated store pages, then publish your funnel

updates.title: Threads Post Sync in Social Planner- Labs
updates.content:
**Threads Post Sync Coming to Social Planner (Beta)**

Threads content will soon sync directly into your Social Planner, giving you a single place to manage, review, and repurpose your Threads posts alongside all your other social channels.

**What's coming:**

- **Automatic Threads import** — pull in existing Threads posts including text, images, videos, carousels, GIFs, and polls
- **Engagement data included** — synced posts carry over captions, media previews, location tags, and engagement metrics (views, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, shares)
- **Clone and repurpose** — reuse existing Threads posts by cloning text, image, video, carousel, and GIF content directly from Social Planner
- **Daily auto-sync** — once enabled, posts sync every 24 hours automatically; sync status and reconnection alerts will be surfaced in the dashboard
- **Up to 365 days of history** — the last 30 days sync by default, with older posts available on demand up to one year back

**A few things to know:**

- This feature will be available as a beta release through Labs
- Sync is one-way (Threads → Social Planner); deleted Threads posts will remain visible in the planner
- Polls can be viewed but not cloned, as poll creation is not yet supported in the Threads composer
- Some engagement data may vary depending on what the Threads API makes available

This one is still on the way — we'll let you know as soon as it's live.

updates.title: Conditional Custom Fields for Opportunities
updates.content:
**Conditional Custom Fields for Opportunities** *(Coming Soon)*

Opportunity forms will soon adapt automatically based on deal context — showing only the fields that matter for each pipeline, stage, or status.

**What's coming:**

- Build display and requirement rules using single conditions or AND/OR logic
- Trigger rules based on pipeline, stage, status, dropdown, radio, checkbox, or multi-select field values
- Show or hide individual fields or entire field folders when conditions are met
- Mark visible fields as required and block saves when mandatory fields are incomplete
- Preview rules in real time before activating them
- Rules apply across add, edit, and bulk edit flows on both web and mobile
- Manage pipeline-specific rules directly from the Pipelines settings page
- Rules activate immediately upon saving

**Why it matters:**

- Keeps opportunity forms focused and relevant at every stage
- Enforces data collection at the right point in your sales process
- Improves reporting consistency and accuracy across pipelines and teams
- Prevents incomplete records from being saved

**Good to know:**

- Fields not included in any Show rule remain visible by default
- When multiple rules apply, their required-field conditions are combined
- Only Admins can create, edit, or delete rules
- Validation applies on web and mobile; API and automation-based updates are not affected

updates.title: Available Quantity as a Custom Value & Workflow Filter
updates.content:
**Available Quantity as a Workflow Filter & Custom Value**

You can now use product inventory levels to trigger and filter automations — making it easier to act on stock changes without manual monitoring.

**What's new:**
- Abandoned Cart and Order Fulfilled triggers now support Available Quantity as a filter condition
- Available Quantity can be passed as a custom value into supported workflow actions
- Filter logic is structured by product → price → available quantity, giving you precise inventory-based targeting

**How to set it up:**
1. In the **Kayan Automations** tab, open or create a workflow using the **Abandoned Cart** or **Order Fulfilled** trigger
2. In the workflow filters, select **Global Products** and choose a specific product
3. Select a single **Price** under that product
4. Configure the **Available Quantity** condition with your chosen operator (e.g. less than, equals) and a numeric value
5. To use inventory data downstream, insert **Available Quantity** or **Price** as a custom value in any supported workflow action

**Keep in mind:**
- Filters follow this nesting order: Global Products → Price → Available Quantity
- Only a single Price and a single numeric quantity value are supported at this time
- Available Quantity and Price cannot be used inside If/Else branches in the current version

updates.title: 🔗 Generate & Copy Reschedule Links Directly from Appointments
updates.content:
**Generate & Copy Reschedule Links from Any Appointment**

When a customer needs to reschedule, you can now generate and copy a reschedule link directly from the appointment — no digging through old emails required. Available for both Meetings and Services.

**What's new:**
- Generate a reschedule link on demand from any existing appointment
- View the link instantly and copy it to your clipboard in one click
- Share it via any channel — chat, email, SMS, wherever works best
- Customers can open the link and pick a new time immediately
- Existing appointment permissions apply — users without appointment management access won't be able to generate links

**How to set it up:**

1. Open any appointment from your Kayan dashboard (accessible via Contacts, Conversations, Appointments, or Opportunities)
2. Click the **Appointment Actions** icon
3. Select **Generate Reschedule Link**
4. Click **Copy Link** once it appears
5. Send it to your customer through your preferred channel

That's it — the customer follows the link and selects a new time on their own.

updates.title: 📅 Week Start Preferences Are Now Consistent Across Calendars
updates.content:
**Week Start Preferences Now Consistent Across All Calendar Types**

Your preferred start day of the week is now applied consistently across every scheduling experience in Kayan — no more mismatches between different calendar views.

**What's new:**
- Choose Saturday, Sunday, or Monday as your week start for Meetings, Services, and Rentals separately
- Your preference now carries through consistently across:
  - Calendar views
  - Appointment creation and editing
  - Schedules and availability settings
  - Staff availability
  - Date pickers
  - Business operating hours
- Booking widget week start settings remain independent — your internal preference won't override your customer-facing widget configuration

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to your **Calendars** section
2. Set your week start preference per calendar type:
   - **Meetings** → Meetings > Preferences
   - **Services** → Services > Global Settings > In-App Settings
   - **Rentals** → Rentals > Global Settings > In-App Settings
3. Select your preferred start day: Saturday, Sunday, or Monday
4. Save — your preference will apply automatically across all relevant in-app scheduling views

updates.title: ✨ Services (v2): Enhancements
updates.content:
**Services Booking: New Enhancements**

Kayan's Services module just got a meaningful upgrade — more notification channels, smarter email personalization, flexible category layouts, and better out-of-the-box defaults so you spend less time configuring and more time serving clients.

**What's new:**

- **WhatsApp Notifications for Services** — In addition to Email and SMS, you can now send WhatsApp notifications at any stage of the booking journey: confirmations, reminders, follow-ups, and more. Reach clients on the channel they actually use.
- **Service & Rental Custom Values in the Email Builder** — When building service-related emails, you can now insert Service and Rental custom values directly from the Email Builder. No more manually typing or hunting for variable names — pick them from the list and drop them into your content.
- **Top Tabs Layout for Service Categories** — Your booking widget now supports a Top Tabs display for Service Categories, giving clients a clean, easy way to browse between categories during the booking flow.
- **Smarter Default Settings** — Key settings that improve the booking experience are now enabled by default, including: allowing clients to explore services outside the category they landed on, and allowing clients to book multiple services in a single session. Both can still be adjusted to fit your workflow.

---

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, navigate to the **Services** section and open the service you want to configure.
2. Under **Notifications**, select **WhatsApp** as a notification channel and set up messages for the booking stages you want to cover.
3. To use Service or Rental custom values in emails, open the **Email Builder**, place your cursor where you want the value, and select it from the custom values picker.
4. To update your booking widget's category display, go to your widget settings and switch the layout to **Top Tabs** under Category Display.
5. Review your booking flow defaults under **Booking Settings** — multi-service booking and cross-category browsing are now on by default, but can be toggled off if needed.

updates.title: Gift Cards: Redeem Gift Cards While Collecting Calendar Payments
updates.content:
**Gift Cards: Redeem Gift Cards During Calendar Payment Collection**

You can now apply a customer's Gift Card balance when collecting payment for an appointment — without requiring the customer to initiate it themselves. Works across Meetings, Services, and Rentals calendars.

**What's new:**
- Apply a customer's Gift Card balance when collecting payment on their behalf, including when charging a saved card or adding a new one
- Full balance coverage: if the Gift Card covers the total, no additional payment method is charged
- Partial balance: Gift Card is applied first, remaining amount is automatically charged to the customer's saved payment method
- Invalid, expired, or zero-balance Gift Cards surface clear validation messages
- Transaction details show exactly how much was redeemed via Gift Card; split payments display each amount separately
- The associated Gift Card order updates automatically with the remaining balance after each redemption

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the relevant appointment in your Kayan dashboard
2. Navigate to the **Payments** tab within the appointment
3. Click **Collect Payment**
4. Select **Charge a Card**
5. Choose **Redeem a Gift Card** and apply the customer's available balance
6. Any remaining amount after the Gift Card is applied will be charged to the customer's saved payment method

updates.title: 🔐 Control Google Sign-In on Your Client Portal
updates.content:
**Control Google Sign-In on Your Client Portal**

You can now choose whether the "Sign in with Google" button appears on your Client Portal login and sign-up pages — giving you direct control over authentication options to meet compliance or data-handling requirements (including GDPR).

**What's new:**
- **Google Sign-In toggle** — Show or hide the Google login button on your portal's sign-up and login pages
- **Self-serve control** — Manage this setting directly from your portal permissions; no support request needed
- **Compliance-ready** — Remove third-party sign-in to align with regional privacy regulations such as GDPR
- When Google Sign-In is disabled, contacts authenticate via email + password or a secure login code

**How to set it up:**
1. In your Kayan dashboard, navigate to **Sites → Client Portal**
2. Open **App Permissions** and scroll to **Sign-up & sign-in methods**
3. Toggle **Disable Google sign-in & sign-up** on or off
4. Click **Save Settings**

updates.title: 🚀 New Communities Triggers in Workflows: Automate More, Faster
updates.content:
**4 New Community Triggers Now Live in Kayan Automations**

Automate responses to member activity inside your communities — without lifting a finger. Four new triggers are now available in Kayan Automations, letting you act instantly on group joins, posts, comments, and event registrations.

**What's new:**

- **Join Request Rejected** — Triggers when a member's request to join a group is declined. Filter by group.
- **Group Post Created** — Triggers when a new post is published in a group. Filter by group, channel, post title, or post content.
- **Group Comment Created** — Triggers when a comment is added to a group post. Filter by group, channel, post title, post content, or comment content.
