- **Member Registered for Event** — Triggers when a member signs up for a group event. Filter by group or event title.

**How to set it up:**

1. Go to the **Automations** tab in your Kayan dashboard.
2. Create a new automation or open an existing one.
3. Click **Add Trigger** and search for "Community" to find the new options.
4. Select your trigger, set the required group filter, and add any optional filters to narrow targeting.
5. Configure your actions, save, and publish.

updates.title: RCS Messaging is Now Available in Workflows (Private Beta)
updates.content:
**RCS Messaging in Automations — Coming Soon**

Kayan.ai is bringing RCS messaging directly into your automation workflows, enabling richer, more interactive customer conversations beyond standard SMS.

**What's coming:**
- Send standard RCS messages as automated actions within your workflows
- Build interactive RCS experiences with rich cards and buttons
- Route contacts down different workflow paths based on how they respond or interact
- Automate reminders, follow-ups, promotions, and engagement sequences using RCS
- 1:1 and bulk RCS messaging from the Conversations view
- RCS template creation and management

This capability is currently in private beta. General availability is planned for later in 2026. Early access details will be shared as the rollout progresses.

updates.title: Some email types are now exempted from DND
updates.content:
**Critical Emails Now Bypass DND Restrictions**

Certain time-sensitive emails will now reach contacts even when they're marked as Do Not Disturb (DND) — ensuring important operational communications are never silently dropped.

**What's changed:**
- **Payment emails** (invoices) are now delivered regardless of DND status
- **Calendar notifications** are no longer blocked by DND
- **System notifications** will always reach contacts as intended

**Why it matters:**
DND is designed to suppress marketing and promotional messages — not block invoices, appointment reminders, or system alerts. These three email types are transactional by nature, and failing to deliver them creates real operational problems for both you and your contacts. This update corrects that gap.

> **Note:** This is not a blanket DND override. All marketing and promotional emails continue to fully respect DND preferences. Only the three categories above are exempt.

---

**How to set it up**

No configuration needed — this is active automatically across your Kayan dashboard.

1. Open **Contacts** and locate any contact marked as DND
2. Confirm their DND status is set as usual — no changes required
3. Going forward, invoices, calendar notifications, and system emails will deliver to that contact without interruption

All other email types remain governed by your existing DND rules.

updates.title: 🤖 Ad Manager × Ask AI: Build & Manage Ad Campaigns
updates.content:
**Ad Manager + AI Assistant: Build and Manage Campaigns Through Conversation**

You can now create, manage, and analyze Meta and Google Ads campaigns directly through Kayan's AI Assistant — no manual screen-by-screen navigation required. Just describe what you want to do, and the AI handles the configuration.

**What's New**

- **Conversational campaign creation** — Describe your campaign goal and the AI collects requirements, configures supported settings, and builds a draft for your review before anything goes live. Supported types include Meta (Lead Generation, Website Traffic, Engagement, Sales) and Google (Search, Demand Gen)
- **Campaign management via chat** — List, filter, review, edit, clone, pause, resume, republish, or delete campaigns across Meta and Google. Confirmation is required before any destructive or publishing action
- **Audience creation and management** — Build and manage Meta audiences (custom, lookalike, website, Page engagement, lead form, Smart List) and Google audiences (Customer Match, website visitor, lookalike, interest, custom, Demand Gen segments) through natural conversation
- **Resource lookup built in** — The AI retrieves the supporting assets you need during setup: Meta Pages, Instagram accounts, pixels, lead forms, Google conversion actions, keywords, locations, languages, demographics, and more
- **Performance insights on demand** — Request performance data across campaigns, ad sets, ads, and keywords for any date range. Results are presented as summaries, metric breakdowns, trend graphs, or improvement suggestions
- **Account connection guidance** — The AI walks you through connecting and authorizing Meta and Google ad accounts within your existing permissions and access rules
- **Draft-first, approval-based publishing** — Campaigns are saved as drafts by default. Publishing, deleting, and account disconnections always require explicit user confirmation

**How to Set It Up**

1. Open the AI Assistant from your Kayan dashboard
2. Describe the advertising task you want to complete (e.g. *"Create a Meta lead generation campaign"* or *"Show my active Google campaigns"*)
3. Provide any additional details the AI requests
4. Review the generated draft or proposed action
5. Approve to publish or apply — nothing executes without your confirmation

**Notes**
- Supports Meta Ads and Google Ads; LinkedIn Ads are not included at this time
- All existing ad account permissions and platform compliance rules remain in effect
- Unsupported actions will redirect you to the relevant section of the Kayan Ad Manager

updates.title: Improved Abandoned Checkouts with Export, Filters & Notifications
updates.content:
**Abandoned Checkouts: Export, Filters & Notifications**

The Abandoned Checkouts section has been redesigned with new tools to help you find, manage, and act on incomplete purchases faster.

**What's new:**
- **CSV Export** — Select one, several, or all records on the current page and export customer, cart, product, activity, and recovery details
- **Search & Filters** — Search by customer name or email, and filter by Email Status, Recovery Status, or Date Range
- **Notification Settings** — Access abandoned cart notification settings directly from the page via a new quick-access button
- **Shareable Recovery Links** — Open any abandoned checkout to copy and share its URL directly with the customer so they can return and complete their purchase
- **UI Improvements** — Refreshed empty states, loading states, pagination, and responsive layout throughout

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Payments → Orders → Abandoned Checkouts**
2. Use the search bar or **Add Filter** to narrow down records by customer, email status, recovery status, or date range
3. Select the records you want, then click **Export CSV** to download the data
4. Click **Configure Notifications** to manage your abandoned cart notification settings

**A few things to note:**
- Export becomes available only after at least one record is selected
- "Select All" applies to the current page only
- Exports exceeding 5,000 records will be sent to you by email

updates.title: 🚀 Multi-role signing for your Documents and Contracts templates, right inside Workflows.
updates.content:
**Multi-Role Signing for Documents & Contracts in Automations**

You can now define multiple signer roles directly on your document templates and route them automatically through Kayan Automations — no manual re-entry, no workarounds.

**What's new:**

- Add up to 6 signer roles per template (e.g. buyer, seller, witness, or any custom role you define)
- Assign fields — signature, date, and more — to each individual role
- When a document is sent via an Automation, all roles auto-populate based on your template setup
- Override any role's name, email, or phone at the automation level without editing the template
- One template can serve multiple deal types — just adjust role details per automation as needed
- If a required email is missing, you'll be prompted before the document goes out; duplicate emails across roles trigger an alert

**How to set it up:**

1. **Build your template** — Open your document template in the Kayan dashboard, define your signer roles (name, email, phone), and assign at least one fillable field to each role
2. **Assign a Contact field** — At least one fillable element must be assigned to the Contact role; this is required for the automation send action to work
3. **Add to your Automation** — In the Kayan Automations tab, add a Send Document action and select your multi-role template; roles will auto-populate
4. **Override if needed** — Adjust any role's details at the automation step level; these values take precedence over template defaults
5. **Activate** — Each signer receives their copy in the role and order you've defined

**Good to know:**
- Roles auto-populate only when sent via an Automation, not through manual send
- Role definitions are local to each individual template
- Available on web

updates.title: Client Portal — One Portal. Zero Tab-Hopping
updates.content:
**Client Portal — One Home for Everything**

Your client-facing portal is now a single, unified experience. Dashboard, Courses, Communities, Billing, Shared Files, Affiliates, and Account Settings all live under one roof — one login, one navigation, no tab-switching.

**What's new:**

- **Unified portal architecture** — Courses, Communities, and the Client Portal now share a common foundation. Features and user flows work across all of them seamlessly, with no product boundaries getting in the way.
- **Redesigned Dashboard** — Clients land on a real launchpad: courses in progress, community activity, pending invoices, recently shared files, and pinned communities all surface immediately. Content loads in ~0.4s and becomes interactive roughly a second sooner than before.
- **Business tools in the portal** — Invoices, estimates, contracts, shared files, and affiliate access are all reachable without leaving the experience.
- **Redesigned Communities UI** — Discussions, events, leaderboards, member directories, and community content are now part of the unified portal. Cleaner interface, consistent navigation, no separate app.
- **Connected Course experience** — Clients can discover courses, track progress, and move between lessons while staying inside the same branded environment.
- **Smoother transitions** — Polished page-change animations and faster load times across desktop and mobile.
- **SEO-ready public pages** — Public Course and Community pages now have search-friendly rendering, crawlable URLs, and page metadata. Lighthouse SEO scores of 92–100, up from 75–85. Private and gated content stays protected.

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open your **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to **Sites → Client Portal**.
2. Review your portal sections — Dashboard, Courses, Communities, Billing, Shared Files, and Affiliates should all appear within the unified navigation automatically.
3. Go to **Branding settings** within the portal to confirm your logo, colors, and domain are applied consistently across all sections.
4. Check any public Course or Community pages and verify metadata is configured under each item's settings to take advantage of the SEO improvements.
5. Share the portal login link with your clients — they'll land on the redesigned Dashboard and have access to everything from one place.

updates.title: 🎉 Smarter Drip Campaigns with Review Date Range Targeting
updates.content:
**Smarter Drip Campaigns with Review Date Range Targeting**

You can now target reviews by an exact date range when setting up a drip campaign — no more relying solely on a fixed review age window.

**What's new:**
- Define a specific start and end date to target a precise batch of reviews
- See the total number of eligible reviews before launching
- Get instant validation if your selected filters return no matching reviews — preventing empty campaigns from being created
- Existing age-based drip campaigns continue running without any changes required

**How to set it up:**
1. In your Kayan dashboard, navigate to **Reputation → Settings → Reviews AI**
2. Open the **Drip Campaign** section
3. When creating a new campaign, select **Date Range** as your targeting method and define your start and end dates
4. Review the eligible review count shown before confirming
5. Launch once you've confirmed the campaign has matching reviews

updates.title: Communities UI - New Experience Inside Unified Clientportal and Gokollab
updates.content:
**Communities & Courses: Rebuilt Inside the Client Portal**

Communities has been fully rebuilt inside the Kayan Client Portal, delivering a faster, unified experience for both members and admins — no unnecessary reloads, no context switching.

**What's new:**

- Members can move seamlessly between community discussions and courses without leaving the portal
- Courses open directly within the Learning tab and resume from the exact lesson where the member left off
- Progress is preserved when switching between courses and discussions
- Communities, Courses, Dashboard, and Billing now share consistent navigation and faster page transitions
- The discussion feed has been redesigned — comments, replies, and attachments display directly inline
- Redesigned post and comment editors make writing and responding more intuitive
- Members can react to posts and comments with six reaction types
- Post nudges encourage participation when engagement is low
- Unified search covers posts, comments, and members from one place
- Profile popovers give a quick member overview without leaving the page
- Creating community events is now a streamlined flow
- Admins can manage posts directly from the feed: pin/unpin, move between channels, disable comments, ban users, download recordings, report, or delete
- Community settings are reorganized into dedicated sections for easier configuration — covering group access, invitations, member profiles, branding, membership questions, and themes

**How to set it up:**

1. Go to your **Kayan dashboard** and open the **Client Portal** section
2. Select **Enable** to activate the new experience
3. No migration needed — existing community content, members, courses, and settings carry over automatically

updates.title: 🎉 Choose Your Sender for Review Requests
updates.content:
**Choose Your Default Sender for Review Requests**

You can now set a default phone number (SMS & WhatsApp) and email address for review requests at the location level — so every request goes out from a consistent, recognisable sender.

**What's new:**
- Set a default SMS, WhatsApp, or email sender for review requests
- Default sender applies automatically across manual requests, campaigns, and automations
- No more system-selected sender identities causing confusion for your contacts

**How to set it up:**
1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Reputation**
2. Open **Settings**
3. Select **Email** or **Phone/WhatsApp Review Request**
4. Choose your preferred default sender and save

updates.title: 📁 Client Portal — File Share Notifications
updates.content:
**Client Portal — File Share Notifications**

Contacts are now automatically notified when you share a file with them through the Client Portal — no more wondering if they saw it.

**What's new:**

- Contacts receive an instant in-app notification when a file is shared with them via the Client Portal
- Push notifications are supported on both the web portal and the Kayan mobile app
- Contacts can manage their own notification preferences directly from their portal settings, choosing which alerts they receive

**How to set it up:**

1. Open a contact record in your Kayan dashboard
2. Navigate to the **Files** section in the right-hand panel
3. Upload a new file or select an existing one
4. Enable the **Upload to Client Portal** option before saving
5. The contact will receive an in-app notification (and push notification, if enabled) as soon as the file is shared

**For contacts managing their preferences:**
Log in to the Client Portal → go to **Settings → Notification Preferences** → toggle In-app and Push Notifications on or off → save.

**Notes:**
- Notifications trigger only when a file is shared through the Client Portal
- Supported channels: in-app and push notifications
- Available on web and mobile

updates.title: SMS Action: Test SMS Now with a Country Picker and enhanced UI
updates.content:
**SMS Test Action: Country Picker + Cleaner UI**

Testing an SMS action now works the way you'd expect — type your number in local format, no manual country codes required.

**What's new:**
- The test phone number field now includes a country flag picker, consistent with the rest of the Kayan dashboard
- Defaults to your account's country automatically
- Numbers are saved in full international format before the test sends, so the country is always resolved correctly
- Click the flag to open a searchable list — search by country name or dialing code
- The old country code hint text is removed; validation error now reads simply "Invalid phone number"

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Automations** tab and navigate to your workflow containing a Send SMS action
2. Click into the Send SMS action and scroll to the **Test Phone Number** field
3. The flag will default to your account's country — leave it as-is or click it to select a different country
4. Type the number in local format (no country code needed)
5. Click **Send Test SMS**

**Example:** If your account is set to India and you type `9089786755`, the test sends to `+919089786755`. Switch the flag to US, type `4088613552`, and it sends to `+14088613552`.

updates.title: Certificate AI Beta is now live
updates.content:
**AI-Generated Certificates — Coming Soon**

Designing a certificate will soon start with a simple description. Kayan's Certificate AI is in beta and will let you go from a text prompt to a fully structured, editable certificate design in minutes.

**What's coming:**

- **AI generation from a prompt** — Describe the certificate you need and AI builds the design for you
- **Guided setup** — AI asks focused questions (like orientation and purpose) to get the details right before generating
- **Full element support** — Designs can include text, frames, signatures, QR codes, and more
- **Fully editable output** — Every AI-generated certificate can be customized directly in the Certificate Builder after creation
- **Quick-start prompts** — Built-in ideas for course completions, milestones, event participation, training programs, and more

This feature is currently in beta. More updates to follow as the experience is refined.

updates.title: 📅 Date Range Setting Can Now Count Only the Days You Actually Work
updates.content:
**📅 Booking Windows Now Count Real Working Days**

The Date Range setting for Calendars, Services, and Rentals now has a smarter counting mode. A new toggle lets you ensure your booking window reflects actual working days — skipping weekends and closed days instead of burning through them silently.

**What's new:**

- **Count available days only toggle** — Enable it below the Date Range setting and the system skips non-working days when calculating your booking window. A business closed on weekends with a 2-day range no longer shows a blank calendar on Fridays — it extends to Monday and Tuesday instead.
- **Works with minimum scheduling notice** — When the toggle is on, the date range starts counting from the first available day after any minimum notice period ends. Bookers always see the full configured window, even when notice rules push it forward.
- **Supported across all calendar types** — Applies to Meeting Calendars, Services, and Rentals, including round robin and collective setups. A day counts as available if at least one assigned team member is free. Date-specific hour overrides are fully respected.

**How to set it up:**

1. In the Kayan dashboard, go to **Calendars** and open the settings for the calendar you want to update. For Services, navigate to **Services → Global Settings → Service Settings**. For Rentals, edit the listing and open **Booking Settings**.
2. Locate the **Date Range** setting.
3. Enable **Count available days only** directly below the Date Range input.
4. Save your changes.

Works for any schedule configuration — standard Mon–Fri, custom days like Mon/Wed/Fri, salons, clinics, field teams, and beyond.

updates.title: Schedule Availability with Custom Open & Expiry Experiences - Form, Survey & Quiz
updates.content:
**Schedule Open & Close Windows for Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes**

You can now set exact open and close times for any Form, Survey, or Quiz — no more manually disabling them after a campaign ends.

**What's new:**

- Set a specific date and time for a form to start accepting submissions, or make it live immediately
- Set an expiry date and time to automatically stop new submissions
- Choose the time zone for both the open and close schedule
- Configure a custom pre-launch page so visitors know what to expect before the window opens
- Configure a custom expired page — or redirect visitors to another URL — once submissions close
- Preview exactly what the unavailable state looks like before publishing
- All existing Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes continue to work as before when scheduling is not enabled

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the Kayan dashboard and navigate to **Forms**, **Surveys**, or **Quizzes**
2. Select the form you want to schedule and open its **Settings**
3. Find and enable the **Schedule** visibility option
4. Set your **Open** date — choose *Right away* or pick a specific date and time
5. Set your **Close** date — choose *Never* or pick a specific date and time
6. Select the correct **time zone**
7. Configure what visitors see outside the active window — either a custom message page or a redirect URL
8. Save and publish — Kayan handles the rest automatically

**Good for:** event registrations, flash sales, webinar sign-ups, contests, limited-time offers, and any campaign with a hard deadline.

updates.title: WhatsApp messaging limits: now shown at the portfolio level
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Messaging Limits Now Reflect Meta's Portfolio Model**

Meta has moved WhatsApp messaging limits from individual phone numbers to the business portfolio (WABA) level. Kayan.ai now displays this accurately — one shared daily limit across all numbers in your portfolio, so you're always working with a clear, real ceiling.

> ⚠️ One high-volume number can consume your entire portfolio's daily capacity. Kayan now surfaces the single limit that actually governs what your business can send.

---

**What's changed**

- **Portfolio-level limit panel** — A new Messaging Limits panel shows the single shared limit that applies across all your WhatsApp numbers, replacing the old per-number display.
- **Per-number limit column removed** — The individual limit column has been removed from the Phone Numbers view. It was misleading under Meta's model and is gone.
- **Tooltip for clarity** — A tooltip explains that the limit is shared portfolio-wide and that one number can exhaust the full daily quota.
- **Fully localized** — The new panel is available in 13 languages.

updates.title: Clearer Card-on-File & $0 Payment Handling for Calendars

Kayan now separates two distinct booking payment scenarios — collecting a card on file versus processing an actual charge — so customers only see what's relevant to their booking.

**What's new:**

- A dedicated **Collect Card on File** option is now available in Calendar Payment settings
- When enabled, customers securely save their card during booking with no charge and no transaction created
- When **Charge Upfront** is enabled, payment collection now responds to the final amount due:
  - Final amount > $0 → payment details collected and charge processed normally
  - Configured amount = $0 → card collection and payment skipped entirely
  - Coupon reduces amount to $0 → card collection and payment skipped entirely
  - Coupon leaves amount > $0 → discounted amount collected normally
- Customers with genuinely free bookings will no longer be prompted for card details or put through a $0 transaction

**How to set it up:**

1. Go to your **Kayan dashboard** and open **Calendars**
2. Select the calendar you want to update and open its **Payment settings**
3. To save a card without charging: enable **Collect Card on File**
4. To charge based on the final booking amount: enable **Charge Upfront** — Kayan will automatically handle $0 and discounted scenarios from there
5. Save your changes

Ringback tones are now localized to match the country of the phone number involved, across 37 countries.

**What's changed:**
- Inbound call forwarding plays the caller's local ringback tone
- Outbound calls use the local tone for the destination country
- IVR call routing respects the caller's regional tone
- Voice AI transfers play the correct tone for the country involved

**How to set it up:**

No configuration needed — this applies automatically based on the phone numbers in use. To confirm your numbers are set up correctly:

1. Go to your **Kayan dashboard** and open **Settings → Phone Numbers**
2. Verify that each number is assigned to the correct country
3. Make a test call to confirm the ringback tone matches what callers in that country expect

If a number is misconfigured to the wrong country, update it here and the correct tone will apply immediately.

updates.title: Single Page Unpublish for Funnels and Websites
updates.content:
**Single Page Unpublish for Funnels and Websites**

You can now take individual pages offline without touching the rest of your site. Hide outdated content, pause seasonal promotions, or manage campaigns granularly — all without disconnecting your domain or deleting a page permanently.

**What's new**

- **Granular page control:** Publish or unpublish a single funnel or website page while everything else stays live. The option is available directly from each page's actions menu — in both the page list and the builder's side panel.
- **Full page management inside the builder:** The side panel now includes a complete actions menu per page — Edit (rename/change URL slug), Preview, Clone, Publish, Unpublish, Edit Redirect Link, and Delete. The menu adapts based on the page's current state.
- **Built-in redirects:** When unpublishing, choose what visitors see at the old URL — a 404, a redirect to another page in the same funnel/website, or any external URL.
- **Editable redirects anytime:** Already unpublished a page? Update where its traffic goes at any time via Edit Redirect Link, without changing the page's publish state.
- **Status visibility everywhere:** Unpublished pages display a clear tag in the page list and sidebar. The builder header shows a live status chip (• Live / • Unpublished), the page's URL, and who last changed its status.
- **A/B test handling:** Unpublishing a page with an active A/B test automatically stops the test — all historical metrics are preserved.
- **Instant effect:** Status changes take effect immediately. No full-funnel republish needed.
- **Zero domain disruption:** Unpublishing a page does not affect your domain's SSL certificate or DNS settings.
- **Team accountability:** Every publish/unpublish action logs who made the change and when.

---

**How to set it up**

1. Open the funnel or website you want to manage in your Kayan dashboard and navigate to its page list.
2. Find the page you want to take offline and open its **Options** menu.
3. Select **Unpublish**. A confirmation dialog will appear explaining exactly what will and won't be affected.
4. Choose your redirect behavior: standard 404, redirect to another page in the same funnel/website, or redirect to a custom external URL.
5. Confirm. The page goes offline immediately — all other published pages are unaffected.
6. To update the redirect destination later, open the page's Options menu and select **Edit Redirect Link**.
7. To bring the page back, select **Publish** from the same menu — it goes live instantly.
8. Everything above is also accessible from the pages side panel inside the builder — no need to leave the canvas.

updates.title: Zero-Dollar Checkout for Sell Products - Forms & Surveys
updates.content:
**Zero-Dollar Checkout for Forms & Surveys**

Free offers shouldn't ask for a credit card. Kayan now lets you skip payment fields entirely when a product order totals $0 — no workarounds needed.

**What's new**

- New **Require card for $0 orders** toggle on the Sell Products element in Forms and Surveys
- When toggled off, payment fields are automatically hidden any time an order totals $0 with no recurring charges due
- Works for coupon-driven zeros too — a 100% discount hides the card the moment the total hits $0
- Free orders are still created and recorded; submission history and order records remain intact
- Subscriptions, free trials, and any order with a future recurring charge always require a card regardless of this setting
- If the $0 total can't be confirmed (e.g. pricing still loading, totals mid-update), the card field is shown as a safe fallback
- For Sell Products elements embedded inside a Funnel, the Funnel-level card requirement takes precedence over the element-level toggle
- Existing Forms and Surveys are unaffected — the toggle defaults to on, so nothing changes unless you turn it off
- Fully supported on desktop and mobile

**How to set it up**

1. Open the Kayan dashboard and navigate to your Form or Survey builder.
2. Add or select an existing **Sell Products** element.
3. In the element settings, locate **Require card for $0 orders** and toggle it off.
4. Save and publish. Customers whose order totals $0 with nothing recurring will now complete checkout without entering card details.
5. If the Form or Survey is embedded inside a Funnel, adjust the card requirement at the Funnel level instead — that setting takes precedence.

updates.title: Rearrange and Rename Tabs in Communities
updates.content:
**Customize Community Tab Layout — Reorder, Rename & Hide Tabs**

Community admins can now fully control how navigation tabs appear inside their community — reordering them, renaming them to match their own language, and hiding the ones they don't use.

**What's new:**

- **Reorder tabs** — Drag and drop tabs (Discussion, Learning, Events, Leaderboards, Members, About) into any order so the most important sections appear first
- **Rename tabs** — Give any tab a custom label that fits your community's branding and terminology
- **Show/hide tabs** — Toggle individual tabs off without deleting them; changes apply instantly for all members
- Changes are persistent and visible to all members immediately upon saving

**Notes:**
- Only community admins and owners can make these changes
- The Discussion and About tabs cannot be disabled
- Custom tab names display exactly as entered and are not auto-translated

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open your community in the Kayan dashboard and go to **Settings → Community Tabs**
2. Use the drag handle on the left of any tab to reorder it
3. Click the **edit icon** next to a tab to enter a custom name, then confirm
4. Use the toggle switches to show or hide individual tabs
5. Click **Save changes** — the updated layout applies to all members immediately

updates.title: Rich Link & Event Previews in Communities
updates.content:
**Rich Link & Event Previews in Communities**

Shared links and events in Communities now generate rich previews automatically — giving members more context without pulling them out of the conversation.

**What's new:**

- Supported videos play directly from the feed without opening a new tab

updates.title: In labs: Organize and personalize tags with categories and colors
updates.content:

A more organized way to manage your tags is on the way. You'll soon be able to group tags into categories and assign custom colors — making it faster to identify and manage tags across your account.

**What's coming:**

- **Custom tag colors** — assign a color to each tag from a predefined palette or use a color picker to match your brand; uncolored tags default to gray
- **Tag categories** — create categories and group related tags under them for a cleaner, more structured setup
- **Bulk tag management** — move individual tags or multiple tags between categories at once

updates.title: Communities - Smarter Join Requests with Workflow Automation
updates.content:
**Communities: Automate Join Request Review with Workflow Triggers**

Community admins can now connect join requests directly to Kayan Automations — automatically screening, routing, and approving (or flagging) submissions without manual review.

**What's new:**

- **New trigger: Requested to Join Group** — fires whenever a user submits a join request, giving you a starting point to build a full approval workflow around it
- **Dynamic membership question filters** — filter the trigger by group and by the actual answers users submit; questions update automatically based on whichever group you select
- **AI-powered screening** — pass membership question responses into a GPT prompt to detect spam, low-quality answers, or mismatched applicants before granting access
- **Conditional branching** — use If/Else logic to automatically approve and grant group access, or route the request for manual review, based on GPT output or response values
- **Follow-up actions** — chain on actions like granting group access, sending a welcome message, or tagging the contact

**Notes:**
- This trigger fires on join requests only; the group must have request-based access enabled
- GPT actions incur additional charges per execution

---

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to the **Automations** tab and create a new workflow
2. Add the **Requested to Join Group** trigger and select the target group — membership question filters will populate automatically
3. Optionally, add a GPT action and pass in the membership question responses (e.g., prompt it to flag spam or off-topic answers)
4. Add an **If/Else** condition branching on the GPT result or specific response values
5. On each branch, add your actions — **Grant Group Access**, send a message, apply a tag, or assign for manual review
6. Activate the workflow — no changes needed on the member side

updates.title: Client Portal — Invoice & Estimate Notifications for Contacts 🔔

- When a new invoice is issued, the contact sees an automatic notification inside their Client Portal
- When a new estimate is issued, the contact is notified immediately and can review or respond without manually navigating to the Estimates section
- Billing alerts surface in the Portal notification center as soon as they're triggered
- Contacts can tap the notification to go directly to the relevant invoice or estimate and take action

No configuration required. Notifications are automatically active for any contact with Client Portal access.

As a contact:

2. When a new invoice or estimate is issued to you, a notification appears automatically
3. Open the Notifications panel

**Notes**
- Notifications are triggered per contact when a new invoice or estimate is issued to them
- Currently supported channel: in-app notifications only

updates.title: Appointments in the Client Portal
updates.content:
**Client Portal Now Includes Appointment Management**

Clients can book, view, and manage appointments directly inside the Client Portal — no more bouncing between emails, separate booking links, or external tools.

**What's new:**

- **Unified appointment view** — Clients see all appointments in one place with Today, Upcoming, and Past filters, plus a full calendar view with date, time, and status details
- **In-portal booking** — Clients book new appointments without leaving the portal; their contact info is pre-filled automatically, cutting out repetitive data entry
- **Multi-calendar support** — If you've enabled more than one calendar, clients can choose which one to book with
- **Book again** — After a completed appointment, clients can instantly rebook from the same place
- **Reschedule and cancel** — Eligible appointments can be rescheduled or cancelled directly by the client, reducing inbound requests to your team
- **You control what's available** — Choose which calendars appear in the portal and toggle the entire Appointments experience on or off through permissions

---

**How to set it up:**

1. **Enable calendars for portal booking**
   Go to your Kayan dashboard → **Calendars** → open the calendar you want to make available → navigate to **Booking Channels** → turn on Client Portal booking → save. Repeat for each calendar you want clients to access.

2. **Turn on the Appointments feature**
   Go to **Client Portal** → **Settings** → **App Permissions** → enable **Appointments** → save.

Once enabled, clients will see the Appointments section the next time they log into their portal.

> **Note:** Appointment management is available in the updated Client Portal interface.

updates.title: Native Speech-to-Speech Voice AI Support in Chat Widget
updates.content:
**Native Speech-to-Speech Voice AI Coming to Chat Widget**

Kayan's Chat Widget will soon support Speech-to-Speech (S2S) Voice AI agents alongside existing Voice AI agents — giving you a single, unified experience for deploying voice capabilities directly on your website.

**What's coming:**

- S2S and standard Voice AI agents will appear together in a single agent dropdown inside the Chat Widget builder
- The widget will automatically detect which agent type is selected and launch the correct voice experience — no manual configuration needed
- Switching an existing agent to an S2S model will automatically update any widgets already using that agent — no code changes, no re-embedding required
- The existing calling experience stays intact: two-way audio, mute/unmute, call status, and end-call controls remain unchanged
- The S2S SDK will only load when a visitor initiates a call with an S2S agent, keeping standard widget performance unaffected

This update removes the need for separate setup flows and lets you upgrade voice experiences across your site without touching a single line of embed code.

updates.title: AI Agent action now upto 50% cheaper to run
updates.content:
**AI Agent Action: Up to 50% Cheaper Per Execution**

Running AI Agents in your automations just got significantly more affordable. Kayan.ai has shipped a set of cost optimizations across the agent execution pipeline — up to 50% cheaper per run, with zero changes to behavior, output quality, or your existing setup.

**What's New**

- **Up to 50% lower cost per AI Agent execution** across all workflows
- **Prompt caching:** repeated context across agent steps is now cached rather than resent on every call, eliminating redundant token usage
- **Leaner system and tool prompts:** rewritten to be tighter and more precise, reducing token cost on every run
- **Right-sized models for supporting tasks:** internal operations like summarization, structured output, and memory generation now use lighter models — core reasoning stays unchanged
- **Fewer total tokens consumed per execution**, on top of per-call savings
- Heaviest agents benefit most — long conversation and multi-tool agents see the largest cost drop
- High-volume automations are now well within reach

**How to Set It Up**

Nothing to configure. The optimizations are already live and apply automatically to all new and existing AI Agent Actions in your Kayan Automations tab — no changes needed on your end.

updates.title: Clearer and More Accurate Invoice Line Items for Rentals
updates.content:
**Clearer Line Items on Rental Invoices**

Rental invoices now display accurate per-unit pricing and real quantities instead of a single lump-sum line — making charges easier for your customers to read and verify.

**What's new:**

- **Accurate unit pricing** — Each line item shows the true cost per unit alongside the actual quantity booked. Example: a 3-day rental of 4 units at $50/day now shows Unit Price: $135.00 | Qty: 4 | Total: $540.00, rather than a single line of $540.00 at Qty: 1.
- **Consistent per-unit calculations** — Pricing is calculated at the unit level before reaching the final total, keeping results predictable across all discount configurations and booking sizes.
- **Clean invoice totals** — In rare cases involving non-round discount percentages, per-unit rounding may cause totals to vary by $0.01. This is expected and reflects the most accurate representation of the configured price.

**How to set it up:**

No configuration needed — this update applies automatically to all rental invoices in your Kayan dashboard. Open any existing or new rental booking, generate an invoice, and the updated line item format will appear. Verify your line items reflect the correct unit price and quantity before sending to your customer.

updates.title: Chat Widget - Embed Any Chat Widget Inline
updates.content:
**Chat Widget Now Supports Inline Embedding Across All Types**

You can now embed any Kayan chat widget directly inline on a page — not just as a floating bubble in the corner. This gives you full control over where conversations appear within your websites, landing pages, funnels, and custom layouts.

**What's new:**

- Embedded (inline) placement is now available for all chat widget types: All-in-One Chat, Email/SMS, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Live Chat, and Voice AI
- Embedded widgets open automatically and stay open — no bubble, no popup, no minimize option
- The widget displays as a fully visible, always-on conversation experience within the page itself
- For All-in-One Chat, visitors can switch between communication channels without leaving the embedded widget
- The widget builder preview updates in real time when you switch to Embedded placement, and floating-bubble-specific settings are automatically hidden

**How to set it up:**

1. Go to **Chat Widgets** in your Kayan dashboard and open the widget builder
2. Select the chat widget type you want to use
3. Under placement settings, choose **Embedded** instead of Sticky
4. Customise your widget — bubble and popup options will hide automatically since they don't apply
5. Copy the embed code and place it in the page section where you want the chat to appear

Conversations become part of the page, not an interruption to it.

updates.title: Ad Manager: Opportunity Score for Google & LinkedIn Campaigns

- **Platform-aware recommendations** tailored to each channel:

  - *LinkedIn:* evaluates audience and location targeting, budget, creatives, destination URLs, lead-gen setup, language, and campaign-specific requirements

- **Click-to-fix navigation** — select any suggestion to jump directly to the relevant campaign section and make changes without hunting through settings

2. Complete your campaign setup and proceed to the **Review** screen
3. Open the **Opportunity Score** panel to view your overall score and individual recommendations
4. Click any suggestion to navigate directly to that campaign setting, make your changes, and return to see your updated score
5. Publish when you're satisfied with your readiness level

*Note: Opportunity Score is advisory guidance only — it does not automatically modify your campaign settings or guarantee performance outcomes.*

updates.title: Tags for Courses

updates.title: Client Portal - Shared File Notifications for Clients
updates.content:
**Client Portal – File Share Notifications**

Clients now get notified the moment you share a file with them through the Kayan Client Portal — no more chasing people down to let them know a document is waiting.

updates.title: Version History in AI Builder
updates.content:
**Version History in AI Workflow Builder**

Every AI-generated iteration of your workflow is now tracked and restorable — no more rebuilding from scratch if an AI edit goes wrong.

**What's new:**

- **Artifact card per iteration** — each AI build or edit produces an inline card in the chat at the exact point the change was made
- **Active version indicator** — the card matching your current canvas state gets a purple border so you always know where you are
- **One-click restore** — open the three-dot menu on any older card and select "Restore this version" to revert the canvas instantly
- **Non-destructive navigation** — restoring an older version keeps all newer ones intact; move between iterations freely without losing anything
- **Unsaved pill** — when auto-save is off, cards display an "Unsaved" indicator until the workflow is saved manually; the pill disappears when auto-save is on
- **Unified version timeline** — AI iterations and manual edits appear together in a single Version History, keeping one authoritative source of truth

**How to set it up:**

1. Open your workflow in the Kayan Automations tab and launch the AI Assistant
2. Prompt it to build or edit your workflow — an artifact card appears in chat with a purple border marking it as the active version
3. Prompt another change; the new card takes the purple border and the previous card gains a three-dot menu with "Restore this version"
4. To restore any prior iteration, open its three-dot menu and select "Restore this version" — the canvas updates immediately
5. To view the full timeline, select "Show in version history" from the three-dot menu to open the Version History tab

updates.title: "Explain This Workflow" discovery pill in Snapshot imported workflows
updates.content:
**"Explain This Automation" — Instant Context on Imported Workflows**

Workflows brought in through a template import now surface an "Explain This Automation" pill at the top of the builder. One click opens the AI Assistant with a full breakdown of exactly what that workflow does.

**What's new:**
- **"Explain This Automation" pill** — Appears automatically at the top of any workflow imported via template
- **One-click breakdown** — Opens the AI Assistant with a complete explanation of the workflow's triggers, actions, and branching logic
- **Dismissible** — Dismiss it once and it won't reappear on that workflow

**How to set it up:**

1. Open any workflow you've imported through a Kayan template
2. Click the **"Explain This Automation"** pill at the top of the Kayan Automations builder
3. Review the full breakdown in the AI Assistant panel
4. Ask follow-up questions about specific steps, or describe the changes you want — the AI Builder can apply them directly

Inherited workflows come with no built-in context. This closes that gap at the moment it matters most — right when you open it — and connects you directly into the AI Assistant and AI Builder to understand, question, and edit without leaving the builder.

updates.title: Hover Animations for Buttons
updates.content:
**Hover Animations for Buttons**

Buttons in the Kayan page builder now support dynamic hover effects — no custom CSS required. Choose from 21 built-in animations and fine-tune every parameter directly from the sidebar.

**What's new:**

- **21 hover effects** organized into six categories:
  - *Scale:* Grow, Shrink, Pulse, Bounce In
  - *Rotation:* Rotate, Skew Forward
  - *Movement:* Float, Wobble Horizontal, Buzz
  - *Background:* Fade, Sweep To Right, Sweep To Bottom, Radial In, Bounce To Top
  - *Border:* Ripple Out, Outline In, Underline From Center
  - *Shadow:* Shadow, Glow, Box Shadow Outset
- **Live canvas preview** — hover over any effect card in the sidebar to see it on your button before applying it
- **Contextual controls** — each effect surfaces only the settings relevant to it: scale factor, rotation angle, movement distance, fill/border color, shadow blur and spread, plus universal timing controls (duration, delay, easing)
- **Mobile-safe** — hover states automatically disable on touch devices and screens under 1024px
- **Entrance animation sequencing** — if a button has an entrance animation, the hover effect waits until it completes before activating
- **Replicated elements** — cloned buttons, sticky bar buttons, and nav duplicates automatically inherit hover behavior from the original

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan Page Builder** and select a button on the canvas.
2. In the sidebar, go to the **Animation** tab and select **Hover Animation**.
3. Hover over any effect card to preview it live on your button.
4. Click an effect to apply it.
5. Use the **Adjust** panel below the effect grid to fine-tune timing, color, scale, distance, or shadow settings as needed.

updates.title: Entrance Animations for Sections, Rows and Columns
updates.content:
**Entrance Animations Now Work on Sections, Rows, and Columns**

You can now apply entrance animations directly to layout blocks — not just individual elements. The page builder automatically sequences animations in hierarchy as visitors scroll, so your pages reveal cleanly without manual timing work.

**What's new:**

- **Layout-level animation support** — apply entrance animations to full Sections, Rows, and Columns
- **Expanded animation library** — new and updated options across Fade, Slide, Bounce, Flip, Rotate & Zoom, and Special Effects (including infinite loops like Glow, Rocking, and Bounce)
- **Custom tuning controls** — set Duration (0.1s–3s), Delay (0s–5s), Scale (0.5×–2×), and Easing (Linear, Ease-in, Ease-out, Ease-in-out)
- **Live hover previews** — hover any animation option in the sidebar to preview it on your selected block before applying
- **Automatic sequencing** — animations fire in order (Section → Row → Column → Content); each child waits for its parent to finish
- **Mobile control** — animations are off on mobile by default; enable per block with the new **Enable animations on mobile** toggle, and remaining blocks auto-sequence around any disabled ones
- **Backward compatible** — existing published pages automatically inherit the updated sequencing logic with no re-save required

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the Kayan page builder and select any Section, Row, or Column on the canvas
2. In the sidebar, open the **Animations** tab and choose **Entrance Animation**
3. Hover over any animation option to preview it live on your selected block
4. Click to apply your chosen animation style
5. Adjust Duration, Delay, Scale, and Easing to fine-tune the effect
6. Optionally toggle **Enable animations on mobile** if you want the animation active on mobile devices

updates.title: Hover animations for button in Highlevel Funnel and Website builder
updates.content:
**Hover Animations for Buttons in the Page Builder**

Add interactive hover effects to any button in your funnels or websites — no CSS required.

**What's new:**

- 20 hover effects to choose from: Grow, Shrink, Pulse, Bounce In, Rotate, Float, Skew Forward, Wobble Horizontal, Buzz, Fade, Sweep To Right, Sweep To Bottom, Radial In, Bounce To Top, Ripple Out, Outline In, Underline From Center, Shadow, Glow, and Box Shadow Outset
- Live preview on the canvas — hover an effect card and it plays on your selected button instantly, so you can compare before committing
- Every effect exposes Duration (0.1–3s), Delay (0–5s), and Easing controls, plus only the additional settings relevant to that specific effect:
  - **Scale effects** (Grow, Shrink, Pulse, Bounce In) → Scale (0.5×–2×)
  - **Rotation effects** (Rotate, Skew Forward) → Angle (−180° to 180°)
  - **Movement effects** (Float, Wobble Horizontal, Buzz) → Distance (0–50)
  - **Background effects** (Fade, Sweep To Right, Sweep To Bottom, Radial In, Bounce To Top) → Fill Colour
  - **Border effects** (Ripple Out, Outline In, Underline From Center) → Border Colour, Thickness (1–10px)
