- If a button has an entrance animation, hover activation waits until that entrance completes
- Buttons used multiple times on a page (sticky bars, nav clones) animate consistently with the original
- Entrance animations are now steadier overall — they no longer replay on drag, device switch, or component remount, and only trigger once the element is visible on screen

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the Kayan Page Builder and select a button on the canvas
2. In the sidebar, go to the **Animation** tab and select **Hover Animation**
3. Pick an effect from the grid — it previews live on your button
4. Once selected, the **Adjust** panel below the grid shows the controls specific to that effect
5. Set your Duration, Delay, and Easing as needed, then publish

updates.title: ✨ Ask AI in Mobile App Can Now Read Your Files ✨
updates.content:
**AI Assistant on Mobile Now Reads Your Files**

The AI Assistant in the Kayan mobile app now accepts images and documents directly in the chat. Attach a file, ask your question, and get answers based on your actual content — no retyping required.

**What's new:**
- Tap the attachment icon in the chat composer to upload from your Camera, Gallery, device Files, or your Kayan Media Library
- Files upload in the background while you continue typing
- Attached files appear as a preview chip in the composer before you send
- The assistant reads the file content directly, so responses reflect your real data — not a summary you typed out
- Supported sources include photos, PDFs, and files already stored in your Media Library (no re-upload needed)

**How to set it up:**
1. Open the **AI Assistant** from your Kayan mobile app navigation and start or open a chat
2. Tap the **paperclip icon** in the composer
3. Choose your source: **Camera**, **Gallery**, **Files**, or **Media Library**
4. Wait for the file chip to show as ready, then type your question and send
5. No question ready? Send the file on its own — the assistant will analyze it automatically

*Available on app version 4.21.0 and above.*

updates.title: Redeeming Gift Cards in Offline Payment Flows
updates.content:
**Gift Card Redemption Now Available in Business-Initiated Payment Flows**

You can now apply a customer's Gift Card balance when collecting payments on their behalf — not just on customer-facing checkouts. This brings a consistent redemption experience across every payment flow in Kayan.

**What's new:**

- Gift Card redemption is now supported when recording or collecting payments directly from your dashboard
- Applies across orders, invoices, direct charges, and new subscriptions
- If the Gift Card covers the full amount, no other payment method is charged
- If the balance is partial, the Gift Card is applied first and the remainder is automatically charged to the customer's saved payment method
- Validation messages surface for invalid, expired, or zero-balance Gift Cards
- Transaction details clearly show the Gift Card amount redeemed
- Split payments display the Gift Card and remaining charge separately
- The Gift Card's remaining balance updates automatically after each successful redemption

> **Note:** Gift Card redemption on future-dated or scheduled subscriptions is not yet supported — that's coming soon.

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Navigate to the relevant payment flow in your Kayan dashboard:
   - **Payments → Orders → Record Payment**
   - **Payments → Invoices → Record Payment**
   - **Contacts → Charge Now**
   - **Contacts → Create Subscription**
   - **Payments → Subscriptions → Create Subscription**
2. During the payment process, enter the customer's Gift Card code in the Gift Card field
3. Click **Apply** to validate and apply the available balance
4. Complete the payment — any remaining balance will charge to the customer's saved payment method automatically

updates.title: Workflow Builder: Pick an Email Sender Domain for Each Workflow!
updates.content:
**Workflow Builder: Set a Sender Domain Per Workflow**

You can now assign a specific sending domain to each automation workflow. Every email action inside that workflow sends from that domain — keeping your transactional, promotional, and outreach emails cleanly separated at the domain level.

**What's new:**

- A **Sender Domain** dropdown is now available in Workflow Settings under Sender Details
- Choose any verified dedicated domain on your account, or select **All Domains** to continue using weighted distribution across all configured domains
- Selecting a specific domain + email prefix (e.g. `marketing` + `example.com`) sends all workflow emails as `marketing@example.com`
- If a sender email entered in an individual email action doesn't match the workflow-level domain, a **Sender Domain Mismatch** warning appears — mismatched domains can affect deliverability
- Sender details set inside an individual email action always take final priority over workflow-level settings
- The dropdown only appears if you have at least one verified dedicated domain configured

**Why it matters:**

Previously, all workflows on an account shared the same sending domain. One underperforming campaign could drag down deliverability for your receipts, reminders, and confirmations. Now each workflow carries its own domain reputation — a bad promo run stays contained, and your transactional emails stay clean.

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Go to **Email Services → Dedicated Domains** in your Kayan dashboard and confirm your domain is verified
2. Open the workflow you want to configure and navigate to **Settings**
3. Under **Sender Details**, select your domain from the **Sender Domain** dropdown
4. Enter your **From Name** and **email prefix**, then save
5. All email actions in that workflow will now inherit these sender settings automatically

updates.title: Schema markup auto-generation on Website, Funnel & Webinar publish
updates.content:
**Auto-Generate Schema Markup on Page Publish**

Kayan now automatically generates schema markup for any page published without it — across Websites, Funnels, and Webinars. No more missing structured data because a step got skipped.

**What's new:**

- When enabled, Kayan's AI generates schema markup in the background the moment a page is published without existing schema
- Publishing speed is unaffected — generation runs in parallel and never delays the page going live
- Existing schema is never touched or overwritten
- Works across all publish methods: manual publish, save-triggered publish, and version-history publish
- Applies to Websites, Funnels, and Webinars
- New assets default to **ON**; existing assets default to **OFF** — nothing changes on your current pages unless you switch it on

**Why it matters:**

Schema markup drives rich results in Google and helps AI answer engines understand and cite your content. Auto-generation ensures every published page carries structured data by default, protecting your SEO and AI search visibility without any manual effort.

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the Kayan dashboard and navigate to your Website, Funnel, or Webinar
2. Go to **Settings**, then select the **SEO & AEO** section
3. Toggle **Auto-generate schema** on or off per asset
4. Hit **Save**

That's it. Kayan handles the rest at publish time.

updates.title: Save Progress - Forms, Surveys & Quizzes
updates.content:
**Save Progress for Forms, Surveys & Quizzes**

Respondents can now leave a multi-step form, survey, or quiz mid-way and pick up exactly where they left off — no lost answers, no starting over.

**What's new:**
- A **Save Exit Confirmation** toggle is available in the Settings tab for all Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes
- When enabled, progress is automatically saved if a respondent closes the browser, refreshes, or navigates away before submitting
- On return, a **Resume Progress modal** appears giving respondents the choice to continue where they left off or start fresh
- The Resume modal automatically inherits your form's branding — button color matches your footer color, font matches your label font
- Fully supported on desktop and mobile
- Existing forms are unaffected until you explicitly enable the toggle

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to your Forms, Surveys, or Quizzes builder
2. Select the form you want to update and open its **Settings** tab
3. Enable the **Save Exit Confirmation** toggle
4. Save your changes — progress saving is now active for that form

No additional configuration required. The resume experience is handled automatically for your respondents.

updates.title: Automatically Associate CRM Records with Workflows
updates.content:
**Automatically Associate CRM Records via Workflows** *(Coming Soon)*

A new workflow action is on the way that will let Kayan automatically link related CRM records based on matching field values — no manual association required.

**What's coming:**
- A dedicated **Associate Records** action for Contact, Company, and Custom Object workflows
- Filter-based record matching using one or more field conditions
- Support for merge fields from the enrolled record as filter values
- Flexible match handling — associate the earliest created, latest created, or all matching records
- Ability to apply existing association labels when linking records
- Works across Contacts, Companies, Opportunities, and Custom Objects

**Example use case:** A real estate team could automatically link a buyer contact to property records that match their preferred city, type, and bedroom count — all without touching a single record manually.

This is currently in development. Once live, it will be available directly within the Kayan Automations builder.

updates.title: Separate email templates for Badges
updates.content:
**Separate Email Templates for Welcome Badges**

Welcome Badge emails can now be customized independently from standard Badge Issued emails — so your enrollment-triggered messaging stays distinct without affecting other badge notifications.

**What's new:**
- New **Welcome Badge Issued** notification type, separate from the existing Badge Issued type
- Dedicated email template for welcome badge emails in your portal email settings
- Cleaner separation between Certificate, Badge, and Welcome Badge email configurations
- Enrollment-triggered welcome badges automatically route through the Welcome Badge Issued path

**How to set it up:**
1. Go to your **Kayan dashboard** and open **Client Portal → Email Settings**
2. Locate **Welcome Badge Issued** listed alongside Badge Issued and Certificate Issued
3. Edit the welcome badge email template and adjust mute settings as needed
4. Enrollment-triggered welcome badges will automatically use this template going forward — no additional configuration required

updates.title: Custom credential expiration for Certificates
updates.content:
**Custom Expiration Controls for Certificates**

You can now define exactly how long issued certificates remain valid — and automate reminders before they expire.

**What's new:**
- Set expiration to Never, a fixed date, or relative to the issue date (3, 6, 9, 12, 24, or 36 months)
- Configure reminder offsets so recipients are notified ahead of expiry
- Expiration calculations are timezone-aware
- Expiry status is visible directly in certificate and template lists and modals

**How to set it up:**
1. Open the Kayan dashboard and navigate to your Certificates section
2. Open an existing certificate template or create a new one
3. Locate the Expiration settings and choose Never, a fixed date, or a relative duration from the issue date
4. Optionally configure one or more reminder offsets to notify recipients before their certificate expires
5. Save — all newly issued certificates will automatically calculate and store the correct expiry date based on your settings

updates.title: Layers in Certificate/Badge Builder
updates.content:
**Layers Panel Now Live in Certificate & Badge Builder**

The Certificate & Badge Builder now includes a dedicated Layers panel, giving you full control over element stacking, layer protection, and placeholder validation before any certificate goes out.

**What's new:**

- New **Layers tab** in the builder sidebar shows your full canvas stack at a glance
- Click any layer to select it on the canvas; drag and drop to reorder
- Lock or unlock individual layers — locked layers cannot be moved, resized, deleted, or edited via shortcuts
- Delete unlocked layers directly from the panel without hunting on the canvas
- Invalid custom-field placeholders are flagged with a visible error pill
- Manual save will warn you if broken placeholders exist before publishing (auto-save behavior is unchanged)

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Certificate & Badge Builder** from your Kayan dashboard
2. Select the **Layers** tab in the left sidebar
3. Click rows to select elements, drag to reorder the stack, and use the lock icon to protect layers from accidental edits
4. Before publishing, check for any error pills on placeholder fields and resolve them — certificates won't issue cleanly with invalid custom fields in place

updates.title: Badge automation is now available in Workflows
updates.content:
**Badge Automation Now Available in Kayan Automations**

You can now issue badges and trigger follow-up actions directly inside Kayan Automations — no manual steps required.

**What's new:**
- **Issue Badge action:** Automatically issue a badge to a contact when workflow conditions are met
- **Badge Issued trigger:** Kick off a new automation the moment a badge is issued — send a message, update a contact, or chain into another workflow

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan Automations** tab and create or edit a workflow
2. To issue a badge automatically, add the **Issue Badge** action and select the badge to assign
3. To trigger follow-up steps after a badge is issued, create a new workflow and set **Badge Issued** as the trigger
4. Add your follow-up actions (message, email, contact update, etc.) and publish

updates.title: WhatsApp Analytics in the AI Assistant in Workflows
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Analytics Now Available in the AI Workflow Assistant**

The AI Assistant inside Kayan Automations now covers WhatsApp alongside Email and SMS — ask about any WhatsApp step in plain language and get live delivery and read metrics back instantly.

**What's new:**

- **Delivery and read metrics for WhatsApp steps** — query any WhatsApp step and get total sends, delivered, failed, and pending counts, plus calculated delivery rate, failure rate, and read rate among delivered messages
- **Automatic period-over-period comparison** — specify a time window (e.g. "last 2 weeks") and the Assistant compares it against the preceding period, showing volume movement and whether delivery is trending up or down
- **Insight-led responses** — answers lead with the headline numbers, then surface what changed, with plain-language observations on volume, delivery vs. failure, and read behaviour

**How to set it up:**

1. Open any workflow in the Kayan Automations tab
2. Launch the AI Assistant panel
3. Ask for the data you need — for example: *"Show me WhatsApp delivery stats for this workflow over the last 2 weeks"*
4. No configuration required — it works against your live workflow data immediately

Email, SMS, and WhatsApp performance now resolve through the same conversational interface, so you can assess full workflow performance in one place rather than switching between separate reports and logs.

updates.title: Google Merchant Center Integration for Ecommerce Stores
updates.content:
**Google Merchant Center Integration for Kayan Stores**

Connect your Kayan ecommerce store to Google Merchant Center and automatically sync your products for visibility across Google Shopping and other Google surfaces.

**What's new:**

- Install the Google Merchant Center integration directly from the Kayan App Marketplace and link your Google account
- Select your Merchant Center account and the Kayan store you want to connect — or follow in-app guidance to create a new Merchant Center account and verify your domain
- Eligible products assigned to the connected store sync automatically, including one-time payment and digital products
- Product details, pricing, inventory, images, and variants stay up to date after initial setup
- Errors and warnings surface during and after setup so you can resolve issues before Google reviews your submissions
- Multiple store-to-Merchant Center mappings are supported; each store or Merchant Center account can only be active in one mapping at a time
- A manual Force Sync option is available when you need to trigger an immediate refresh

**How to set it up:**

1. Go to the **Kayan App Marketplace** and install the Google Merchant Center integration
2. Connect your Google account and select your Merchant Center account
3. Choose the Kayan store you want to link
4. Complete setup — eligible products will begin syncing automatically
5. Monitor sync status, errors, and warnings from within the integration; use **Force Sync** if a manual refresh is needed

**Note:** Google controls product review and approval after submission. This integration syncs your products to Merchant Center only — it does not create or manage Google Ads campaigns. A valid, verified store domain is required for sync to work.

updates.title: Client Portal — Graceful OTP Fallback for Expired Magic Links
updates.content:
**Client Portal — Automatic OTP Fallback for Expired Magic Links**

Expired magic links no longer leave contacts stuck. When a magic link has expired, contacts are now automatically redirected to OTP verification so they can regain access on their own — no admin intervention required.

**What's new:**

- **Automatic redirect on expiry** — Clicking an expired magic link now takes contacts straight to the OTP verification screen instead of showing an error
- **OTP sent instantly** — A one-time code is dispatched to the contact's email address without any manual steps
- **Masked email display** — The contact's email address is partially hidden on the verification screen for privacy
- **Self-serve recovery** — Contacts resolve their own access issues independently, reducing support requests related to expired links

**How to set it up:**

No configuration needed. This fallback is active automatically for all Client Portal magic link authentication. No changes are required in your Kayan dashboard.

updates.title: 📢 Course Announcements
updates.content:
**Course Announcements**

Keep learners in the loop without leaving your course environment. You can now create and send announcements directly inside Kayan's course builder — no external email tool required.

**What's new:**

- **Create and manage announcements** — Build, edit, clone, and delete announcements from the Courses admin area
- **Rich content support** — Format text, add images, and include links to make announcements clear and engaging
- **Flexible targeting** — Send to learners in a specific course or broadcast across all courses at once
- **Optional email delivery** — Choose to notify course members by email alongside the in-app announcement
- **In-app visibility** — Learners see new announcements via banners and unread indicators without interrupting their progress
- **Dedicated announcement view** — Learners can browse all announcements and open individual updates without leaving their course

---

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Courses** and select **Announcements**
2. Click to create a new announcement
3. Add a title and your content (text, images, links)
4. Choose your target — a specific course or all courses
5. Toggle on email notifications if you want members to receive it by email as well
6. Publish — learners will see it immediately via the announcement banner and unread indicator in their learning view

updates.title: Targeted Edits in AI Builder
updates.content:
**Targeted Edits in Kayan AI Builder**

The AI Builder now executes scoped edit instructions with significantly higher precision. Name exactly which actions or triggers to change, and it updates only those — nothing else is touched.

**What's new:**

- **Scoped instruction following** — Specify actions or triggers by name, count, or selection. Changes apply to exactly that set, with no unintended edits elsewhere.
- **Bulk copy editing** — Update email, SMS, or other channel copy across multiple actions in a single instruction.
- **Bulk pipeline stage swaps** — Reassign pipeline stages across all or specific actions and triggers at once.
- **Bulk sender identity** — Set From Name and From Email across all or a defined subset of email actions in one pass.
- **Precise partial targeting** — Provide exact copy for a specific subset of actions (e.g., 20 out of 50 emails) and only those are updated.

**How to set it up:**

1. Open a workflow in the Kayan Automations tab and launch the AI assistant from the sidebar.
2. Describe your change and define its scope — for example: *"Set the From Name to Aviv in all email actions"* or *"Update the SMS copy in the first two actions only."*
3. Review the preview, confirm the scope looks correct, and save.

Large, complex automations benefit most — a single instruction now replaces what previously required opening and editing each action by hand.

updates.title: New Channel Management Conversation AI
updates.content:
**Smarter AI Bot Routing by Channel — Coming Soon**

A new way to manage which AI agents respond where is on the way. Instead of relying on a single default bot to handle everything, you'll be able to assign any bot directly to specific channels — with precise control over who it talks to and when.

**What's coming:**

- **No default bot required.** Assign bots directly to individual channels — SMS, Email, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Live Chat, and Web Chat — without designating one as a catch-all.
- **Granular routing.** Route conversations by channel, by specific connected account or number, and by contact tags. For example, send VIP-tagged contacts to one bot and everyone else to another.
- **Priority logic built in.** More specific assignments take precedence over broader ones — a "Facebook + VIP tag" rule wins over a general "Facebook" rule.
- **No conflicting assignments.** Two bots can't share the exact same channel, identifier, and tag combination.
- **Tag-based segmentation.** Include or exclude tags per assignment to split traffic cleanly between bots.
- **Workflow compatibility preserved.** Bots assigned through automation flows will respond across all channels for that contact, no separate channel assignment needed.
- **Multi-account support.** Each connected Facebook Page or Instagram account is treated as a distinct channel — each can be handled by a different bot.
- **Existing setups migrate automatically.** Your current bots carry over without needing to be rebuilt.

updates.title: 🚀 Prospect AI gets an activity center & pipeline integration
updates.content:
**Prospect AI gets an activity center & CRM pipeline integration**

Prospect AI now gives you full visibility into what your AI sales agents are doing — and connects discovered prospects directly to your CRM pipeline without manual work.

**What's new**

- **Redesigned agent cards** — each card now shows total prospects discovered, last successful run, next scheduled run, and agent specialization at a glance
- **New agent workspace** — clicking an agent opens a dedicated home with two views: Summary (config, stats, criteria, schedule) and Activity (full execution history, upcoming runs, success/failure logs)
- **Agent activity center** — see exactly when an agent ran, how many prospects it found, which business categories were discovered, and a complete historical log
- **Actionable failure explanations** — if an agent finds nothing, Prospect AI now tells you why and recommends specific fixes (e.g. widen search radius, adjust scoring filters, reallocate monthly limits)
- **Dashboard metrics** — see total agents, active agents, total prospects discovered, and monthly lead usage across your entire AI team from one view
- **Agent search bar** — quickly find and manage specific agents as your roster grows
- **Native CRM pipeline integration** — when configuring an agent, choose which pipeline and stage newly discovered prospects should land in automatically

**How to set it up**

1. Go to **Prospect AI** in your Kayan dashboard
2. Open any existing agent or create a new one
3. In the agent configuration, scroll to the **CRM Pipeline** section
4. Select the target pipeline and the stage where new prospects should be placed
5. Save — from that point forward, every newly discovered prospect will be added to your pipeline automatically, ready for review and outreach

updates.title: Todoist: Workflow actions & triggers
updates.content:
**Todoist: Workflow Triggers & Actions**

Connect Todoist to Kayan Automations so task activity can fire customer-facing workflows — and any workflow can create, update, or manage Todoist tasks and projects without leaving the builder.

---

**What's new**

- **3 polling triggers** (every 5 minutes): New incomplete task, New completed task, New project
- **12 actions** covering the full task lifecycle: create task, update task, mark complete, add task or project comments, create project, move sections, find tasks, find projects, find user, get collaborators, and invite collaborator
- All Todoist triggers and actions count as premium workflow components — standard automation credit rates apply
- Todoist plan limits (projects, tasks, collaborators) are governed by your Todoist account directly

---

**How to set it up**

**Connect your Todoist account**
1. Go to the **Kayan dashboard → Automations** and open or create a workflow
2. Add a trigger or action, open the **Apps** tab, and search for **Todoist**
3. Select any Todoist trigger or action, then click **Connect your account**
4. Complete the OAuth authorization in Todoist — you'll be returned to the builder once connected

Alternatively, connect via **Settings → Integrations → Todoist → Connect** before building.

**Set up a trigger (example: New incomplete task)**
1. Click **Add trigger**, go to the **Apps** tab, and select **New incomplete task**
2. Choose the connected Todoist account and give the trigger a clear label
3. Optionally filter by project, label, priority, or due date
4. Click **Find new records** to test — if nothing returns, add a task in Todoist, wait one polling cycle (5 min), and re-fetch
5. Select the returned record as your mapping reference, then **Save trigger**

**Set up an action (example: Create task)**
1. Click **Add step**, open the **Apps** tab, and select **Todoist → Create task**
2. Choose the connected account and set a name for the action
3. Fill in the required fields: target project, task title, optional note, and due date or deadline
4. Click **Test action** — this creates a real task in Todoist, so use a test-labeled title if working against a live project
5. Verify in Todoist, clean up test records, then **Save** and run a full workflow test before publishing

---

**Common ways to use it**

- **Form submission → Todoist task:** Route inbound requests into the right project with priority, labels, and the full submission as a note — automatically
- **Task completed → CRM update:** When a Todoist task is marked done, trigger a contact field update, stage change, or notification inside Kayan
- **Operational event → team task with context:** Any workflow event can create a task on a shared project, set priority and labels, and attach a follow-up comment with instructions or links

updates.title: Jira: Workflow actions and triggers
updates.content:
**Jira Integration: Triggers & Actions in Automations**

Jira is now natively connected to Kayan Automations. You can trigger workflows when Jira issues are created or updated, and push actions back into Jira — all without leaving Kayan.

**What's new:**

- **2 triggers** — fire a workflow when a Jira issue is created or updated
- **11 actions** across four categories:
  - *Discovery:* Find users, find projects, find issues
  - *Creation & updates:* Create issue, update issue
  - *Enrichment:* Add comment, add watcher, add attachment, log work
  - *Relationships:* Link issue, move issue to sprint
- OAuth authentication with a friendly account label (name + email) so you can manage multiple connections cleanly
- Cloud Site selector on every trigger and action — one connected Atlassian account can target any of your Jira Cloud sites

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan Automations** tab and create or edit a workflow.
2. Add any Jira trigger or action — you'll be prompted to connect your account.
3. Enter a display name (e.g. "Support Jira") and the email tied to your Jira account, then click **Continue**.
4. Approve the requested permissions on Atlassian's authorization screen. You'll be returned to the workflow automatically.
5. On each Jira step, select the **Cloud Site** it should read from or write to.
6. Save and activate your workflow.

updates.title: WhatsApp usernames
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Username Support — Coming Soon**

WhatsApp is rolling out usernames, allowing users to message businesses without sharing a phone number. Kayan.ai has already built support for this ahead of Meta's rollout — so when it reaches your market, new contacts who message you via username are captured automatically, with no gaps in your lead flow.

**What's coming**

- **Automatic contact capture for username adopters:** When a net-new customer messages you via a WhatsApp username for the first time, Kayan.ai creates a contact using their username and a business-scoped user ID (BSUID) — a stable, account-specific identifier assigned by WhatsApp. No phone number required to keep the lead.
- **Phone-number messaging stays exactly the same:** Every existing conversation, import, and contact record is unaffected. This only applies to brand-new inbounds from customers who have opted into a username.
- **Reply and continue conversations:** Once a username-only contact messages you first, their BSUID is captured and you can reply normally — following the same WhatsApp session-window and template rules that apply to all conversations.
- **No cold outreach to username-only leads:** You cannot initiate an outbound message to someone you only know by username. Outreach is only possible after they've contacted you first and their BSUID is on record.
- **No change to automations, billing, or templates:** Existing workflows continue running without modification.

**Availability**

Meta is releasing usernames in a regional beta. Current markets include Algeria, Azerbaijan, Ghana, Libya, Nepal, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Singapore, Malaysia, and Peru. More regions will follow. No setup will be required — contact capture for username adopters will activate automatically once the feature reaches your market.
